sensesIntro.en: Renowned moves from being famous for a particular thing to being respected for standing, and then to being simply widely known.
sensesIntro.cn: renowned 先从「因某事闻名」出发，接着表示「因地位受推崇」，最后泛指「广为人知」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bell rung in every quarter and one name repeated through the streets.
core.cn: 核心意象：钟声敲遍四方，一个名字在街上被人反复念起。

branches.en: THE SOURCE: renown grows from one visible skill, so renowned was forms the reason-for-fame sentence.
branches.cn: 来源线：名声始于某项看得见的本事，所以 renowned 常以 be renowned for 点名出名原因。

branches.en: THE STANDING: respect joins the name, so the adjective marks a respected position inside a field.
branches.cn: 地位线：敬意加到名字上，这个词便标记某个领域内受人尊敬的地位。

branches.en: THE REACH: a name can travel very far without any special skill behind it.
branches.cn: 范围线：名字可以传得很远，背后却不一定有特别的本事。

branches.en: Reputation for work and respect for the person grow from the same echoed name.
branches.cn: 作品带来的声誉与对人的敬重，都来自同一个被回响的名字。

branches.en: Very many people can know a name, yet true renown keeps the rank of standing attached.
branches.cn: 很多人知道一个名字，但真正的 renowned 仍带着地位上的分量。

intro.en: Renowned is built from a Latin prefix, a naming root and an English participle ending.
intro.cn: renowned 由拉丁语前缀、命名词根和英语分词词尾三部分构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means again, and nominare, from nomen, means to name.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 re- 意为「再、反复」，nominare 出自 nomen（名字），意为「命名」。

items.example: The prefix re- marks doing something over again.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示把某事再做一遍。

items.example: Nomen is the root of nominare and nominate.
items.exampleCN: nomen 是 nominare 与 nominate 的词根。

items.example: The ending -are forms the verb nominare.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -are 构成动词 nominare。

items.meaning: to name again, to call again by name
items.example: Renominare joins re- and nominare.
items.exampleCN: renominare 由 re- 与 nominare 合成。

items.example: Old French renon supplied the noun in Middle English.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 renon 为英语提供了这个词的名词。

items.example: The ending -ed turns renown into the adjective renowned.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 把 renown 变成形容词 renowned。

items.example: The suffix -able forms renomable as a rare adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成罕见形容词 renomable。

items.example: The suffix -ee appears in the rare noun renownee.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ee 出现在罕见名词 renownee 中。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms renownedness.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ness 构成 renownedness。

definition_zh: 租金；租费；出租的；租赁的
definition_en: an amount paid to use something for a period, or something that is rented
core_image: 一张租赁合同按在桌角，旁边是钥匙和一张写着租金的纸条
scene: 周末搬家，中介递来合同，桌上还压着一串钥匙。The monthly rental takes a large share of their income.
sceneCN: 这里 rental 是「房租」（第 1 个义项：为使用房屋等按期支付的租费）；句意：每月的房租占去了他们收入的很大一部分。图中可辨识物件：合同、钥匙、桌角。

pos.zh: 租金；租费；（租来的）租赁物

derivatives.zh: 词根动词，义为「租用；出租」
rent 加 -er，义为「承租人；租户」
rent 加 -able，义为「可出租的」

senses.title: Money paid for using a place or thing
senses.definition: the money paid regularly for the right to use a house, a car or other property
senses.definitionCN: 为获得使用房屋、汽车等财物的权利而定期支付的款项
senses.example: The rental for the flat is due on the first day of each month.
senses.exampleCN: 这套公寓的租金在每月第一天缴纳。
senses.why: Rent is a French word for an income or payment, and -al forms a noun for the amount itself.
senses.whyCN: rent 是法语词，意为一项收入或付款，加上 -al 后构成名词，指租金这笔金额本身。

senses.title: The period of a hire
senses.definition: the period during which something is hired, or the contract covering it
senses.definitionCN: 租用某物的期限，或覆盖该期限的合同
senses.example: The rental runs from June to September.
senses.exampleCN: 租期从六月到九月。
senses.why: A payment for use always runs alongside a stretch of time, so the noun also names the agreed term.
senses.whyCN: 为使用而付的钱总和一段时间绑在一起，于是这个名词也指约定的租期。

senses.title: Property let to someone
senses.definition: a house, flat or property that is let to a tenant
senses.definitionCN: 出租给租户的房屋、公寓或地产
senses.example: They live in a rental near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在车站附近一处租来的房子里。
senses.why: Once the payment marks the property, the property itself can be called the rental.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这份付款标记出那处房产，房产本身也就被称作 rental。

senses.title: Available for hire
senses.definition: available to be hired, usually for a short time
senses.definitionCN: 可供租用的，通常是短期
senses.example: We booked a rental car for the weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 我们为周末订了一辆车。
senses.why: The adjective sense grew from rental car and rental property, where the noun became a modifier.
senses.whyCN: 形容词义从 rental car、rental property 这类说法发展而来，名词成了修饰语。

intro.en: Rental is an English formation from rent, a word carried into Middle English by Old French.
intro.cn: rental 是在英语内部由 rent 构成的词，而 rent 由古法语带入中古英语。

items.en: Redditus, from reddere, to give back, means a return or a yield, and rendita is its popular Latin descendant.
items.cn: 拉丁语 redditus 由 reddere（交回、付出）构成，意为「回报、收益」，通俗拉丁语 rendita 是它的后身。

items.en: Old French rente means an income or a tax paid at regular intervals.
items.cn: 古法语 rente 意为收入，或按期缴纳的贡金。

items.en: Middle English borrowed rent for a payment made for the use of land or a house.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 rent，指为使用土地或房屋而付出的款项。

items.en: The noun rental first meant a rent roll, the record of rents owed.
items.cn: 名词 rental 最初指收租册，即记录应收租金的账册。

items.en: Rental widened to the rent itself and to property that is let, and it also served as an adjective.
items.cn: rental 扩展到租金本身以及出租的财产，同时也用作形容词。

items.en: Matters first used the adjective rental for American property ads; short-term rental is the later digital use.
items.cn: 较早时期美国的房产广告里就用形容词 rental；短租则是后来数字时代的用法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words with the same hire root; the near-meaning group gathers related payments and hire words with different scope.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「租用」词根的一族词；近义组收各类费用与租借词，范围各不相同。

entries.definition: to pay for the use of something, or to let it out
entries.definitionCN: 租用；出租

entries.definition: a person who pays rent for a house or a car
entries.definitionCN: 承租人；租户

entries.definition: able to be let to a tenant
entries.definitionCN: 可出租的

entries.definition: a legal contract for the use of a property
entries.definitionCN: 租约

entries.definition: the holding of a property as a tenant
entries.definitionCN: 租用；租期

entries.definition: the act of paying to use something for a short time
entries.definitionCN: 租用

normalIntro.en: Rental is rent plus -al, the common English ending for an amount or a thing connected with a verb.
normalIntro.cn: rental 是 rent 加 -al，-al 是英语中常见的词尾，表示与某个动作相关的款项或事物。

normal.en: Rental car and rental property are the two most frequent pairs.
normal.cn: rental car 与 rental property 是出现最多的两个搭配。

normal.en: The base word rent is a verb and a noun: to rent a flat, to pay the rent.
normal.cn: 基础词 rent 既是动词也是名词：to rent a flat 指租公寓，pay the rent 指交房租。

normal.en: A renter pays rent, while a landlord receives it.
normal.cn: renter 支付租金，landlord 收租金。

normal.en: Rentable means that a property can find a tenant.
normal.cn: rentable 表示房产能租得出去。

normal.en: Compare lease: a lease is the written contract, a rental is often the short hire or its fee.
normal.cn: 对比 lease：lease 多指书面合同，rental 常指短期租用或租金。

abstract.en: Picture a door key on a contract with a row of coins beside it.
abstract.cn: 想象合同上放着一把门钥匙，旁边排着一小堆硬币。

abstract.en: Imagine a car with a tag that fades away after three days.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆车挂着三天后就消失的标签。

abstract.en: Think of a calendar with a small price printed on every month.
abstract.cn: 想象一本日历，每个月上印着一个小价钱。

examples.en: The rental for the studio includes water and gas.
examples.cn: 这间单间公寓的租金包含水电燃气。

examples.en: They picked up a rental car at the airport.
examples.cn: 他们在机场提取了一辆租来的车。

examples.en: Rents in the city centre have risen sharply this year.
examples.cn: 今年市中心的房租大幅上涨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「韧头」——房租这��事像磨人的「韧」劲儿，每月「头」一天就得交；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 reddere（交回、付出）→ redditus「收益」→ 通俗拉丁语 rendita → 古法语 rente「收入、贡金」→ 中古英语 rent「租金」→ 英语 rental（加 -al），核心义「为使用而付出的定期回报」。

sensesIntro.en: Rental starts from the amount paid for use, then covers the term of the hire, then the property itself, and finally the adjective use.
sensesIntro.cn: rental 先从「为使用付的钱」出发，接着指租用期限，再指出租的财产，最后用作形容词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a contract, a key on the desk and a note with the sum paid each month.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份合同、桌上的钥匙，以及写着每月所付金额的字条。

branches.en: THE MONEY: the regular payment for use is the first and clearest sense.
branches.cn: 金钱线：为使用而定期支付的款项，是最先也最清楚的义项。

branches.en: THE TIME: any payment for use is tied to a stretch of time and the contract over it.
branches.cn: 时间线：任何使用费都绑定一段时间以及覆盖这段时间的合同。

branches.en: THE THING: the sum marks a house or a flat, and the property takes the name.
branches.cn: 事物线：金额标记出房屋或公寓，房产本身便接过了这个名字。

branches.en: THE LABEL: in rental car and rental property the noun turns into a label for things on offer.
branches.cn: 标签线：在 rental car、rental property 里，名词变成了对被出租之物的标签。

branches.en: Short-term rental joins the two branches: a term of days and a thing on offer.
branches.cn: 两端交汇：短租把两条分支合在一起，既是一段天数，也是一件待租之物。

intro.en: Rental is built from a Latin giving-back root, a Latin noun ending and an English noun ending.
intro.cn: rental 由拉丁语「交回」词根、拉丁语名词词尾和英语名词词尾三部分构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin red- plus dare gives reddere, to give back, and redditus, a return or a yield.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 red- 加 dare 构成 reddere（交回），其名词 redditus 意为回报、收益。

items.example: The prefix red- keeps the idea of giving back.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 red- 保留「交回」的意思。

items.example: Dare is the source of the verb reddere.
items.exampleCN: dare 是动词 reddere 的来源。

items.example: Reddere grows into the noun redditus.
items.exampleCN: reddere 发展为名词 redditus。

items.example: The ending -tus forms the noun redditus.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tus 构成名词 redditus。

items.meaning: a return, a yield, an income
items.example: Redditus is behind the popular forms rendere and rendita.
items.exampleCN: redditus 是 rendere 与 rendita 等通俗形式的来源。

items.example: Old French rente is the direct source of English rent.
items.exampleCN: 古法语 rente 是英语 rent 的直接来源。

items.example: The suffix -al turns rent into rental.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -al 把 rent 变成 rental。

items.example: The suffix -er forms renter.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 构成 renter。

items.example: The suffix -able forms rentable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 rentable。

definition_zh: 重新调整方向；重新定位；使适应新情况
definition_en: to change the direction, focus or position of something again
core_image: 一只罗盘被轻轻一转，指针重新对准新的方格
scene: 十字路口的路牌被换了个方向，行人停下脚步抬头看。The company had to reorient itself towards greener products.
sceneCN: 这里 reorient 是「重新调整方向」（第 2 个义项：改变关注点与发展方向）；句意：这家公司不得不把重心转向更环保的产品。图中可辨识物件：路牌、罗盘、路口。

pos.zh: 重新调整方向；重新定位；使适应新情况

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ation，义为「方向的重新调整」
英式常见变体，义同「重新定向」
基础动词，义为「使朝向；确定方向」

senses.title: To turn to face a new direction
senses.titleCN: 转向新方向；重新定方位
senses.definition: to change the position or direction in which something faces
senses.definitionCN: 改变某物朝向的位置或方向
senses.example: The pilot reoriented the plane towards the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员把飞机转向海岸方向。
senses.why: The Latin base oriens means the rising sun and east, and re- adds again, so the verb is literally getting a new east.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语词根 oriens 意为「升起的太阳、东方」，re- 表示「再次」，所以这个动词字面意思就是「重新找到东方」。

senses.title: To shift focus or strategy
senses.definition: to change the focus, aim or strategy of a plan, an organisation or oneself
senses.definitionCN: 改变计划、机构或自身的重心、目标或策略
senses.example: The school reoriented its courses towards practical skills.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校把课程重心转向实用技能。
senses.why: If a compass can be turned to a new point, a plan can be turned to a new aim in the same way.
senses.whyCN: 罗盘能转到新的方位，计划也能同样转向新的目标。

senses.title: To help someone adjust to new conditions
senses.definition: to help someone find their bearings again after a major change
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人在重大变化后重新找到方向
senses.example: The welfare team reoriented the new arrivals to life in the city.
senses.exampleCN: 福利团队帮助新来的人适应城市生活。
senses.why: Finding the east again means knowing where you are, so the verb also covers settling into a strange setting.
senses.whyCN: 重新找到东方就意味着知道自己在哪，所以这个词也涵盖在陌生环境中安定下来。

intro.en: Reorient combines the Latin prefix re- with orient, which comes from the Latin word for the rising sun.
intro.cn: reorient 由拉丁语前缀 re- 与 orient 组合而成，而 orient 出自拉丁语中表示「升起的太阳」的词。

items.en: Oriens, the present participle of oriri, to rise, means the east, the direction of the rising sun.
items.cn: 拉丁语 oriens 是 oriri（升起）的现在分词，意为东方，即太阳升起的方向。

items.en: Orientare means to set facing the east, to turn towards the sunrise.
items.cn: 拉丁语 orientare 意为「使朝东」，即转向日出之处。

items.en: The noun orient came into French and English as a name for the east.
items.cn: 名词 orient 进入法语和英语，用来指东方。

items.en: The verb orient, meaning to find your bearings by facing east, is first recorded in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 动词 orient 意为「以朝东来定方位」，最早见录于十八世纪。

items.en: Re- added again to orient gives reorient, widely used in the twentieth century for aims, plans and people.
items.cn: 在 orient 前面再加 re- 便有了 reorient，二十世纪广泛用于目标、计划和人。

items.en: Reorientate appears as a British variant that follows the longer orientate, with the same meaning.
items.cn: reorientate 是英式变体，跟着较长的 orientate 走，含义相同。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the rising-sun root; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of turning and adjusting direction.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「日出」词根的一族词；近义组收表示转向与调整方向的动词。

entries.definition: to find your bearings, or to set toward a point
entries.definitionCN: 使朝向；确定方向

entries.definition: a change of direction or focus
entries.definitionCN: 方向的重新调整

entries.definition: to make a person lose their sense of direction
entries.definitionCN: 使迷失方向

entries.definition: to send something in a new direction
entries.definitionCN: 使改道；改变投向

entries.definition: to set something right again for a new state
entries.definitionCN: 重新调整

entries.definition: to change yourself to fit a new situation
entries.definitionCN: 适应

normalIntro.en: Reorient is the prefix re- plus orient, whose root is the Latin word for the east and the rising sun.
normalIntro.cn: reorient 是前缀 re- 加 orient，后者词根是拉丁语中表示东方与日出的词。

normal.en: Orient arrived in English from the Latin participle for rising, so the east is built into the word.
normal.cn: orient 源自拉丁语中表示「升起」的分词，所以「东方」这个概念已经内置在词里。

normal.en: Re- plus orient means finding the east again, and by extension turning to a new aim.
normal.cn: re- 加 orient 意为「重新找到东方」，引申为转向新的目标。

normal.en: Disorient is the opposite: to lose the east, and so to lose the way.
normal.cn: disorient 是相反的：丢掉东方，也就丢掉了方向。

normal.en: Reorientation turns the verb into the noun of a change of direction.
normal.cn: reorientation 把动词转成表示「方向改变」的名词。

normal.en: British English also uses reorientate for the same meaning.
normal.cn: 英式英语也用 reorientate 表示同样的意思。

abstract.en: Picture a compass needle swinging round and settling on a new square.
abstract.cn: 想象罗盘指针转了一圈，停在一个新的格子上。

abstract.en: Imagine a map folded again so that the route you need lands in the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象把地图重新折叠，让你需要的那条路线落到正中。

abstract.en: Think of a shop turning its door to a busier street.
abstract.cn: 想象一家店把门转向更热闹的那条街。

examples.en: The telescope had to be reoriented towards the southern sky.
examples.cn: 望远镜必须重新对准南方的天空。

examples.en: Many businesses reoriented their plans after the market changed.
examples.cn: 市场变化后，许多企业重新调整了计划。

examples.en: Teachers reoriented their lessons to meet the new exam.
examples.cn: 教师们调整了课程以适应新的考试。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞欧认特」——某人临走前又「认真」认了一遍方向，才算重新定好位；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 oriri（升起）→ oriens（升起的太阳；东方）→ orientare（使朝东）→ 英语 orient（确定方向）→ re- 加 orient 构成 reorient，核心义「重新找到东方」。

sensesIntro.en: Reorient starts with turning something to a new direction, then widens to a new focus or strategy, and finally to helping people settle in a new setting.
sensesIntro.cn: reorient 先指把某物转向新的方向，再扩展到新的重心或策略，最后指帮助人在新环境中安顿下来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a compass turned by hand until the needle points to a new square.
core.cn: 核心意象：用手转动罗盘，直到指针指向新的方格。

branches.en: THE DIRECTION: a body or a machine given a new bearing is the most physical sense.
branches.cn: 方向线：把身体或机器摆向新方位，是最具体的义项。

branches.en: THE AIM: plans and organisations are turned like a compass to a new point.
branches.cn: 目标线：计划和机构像罗盘一样被转到新的方位。

branches.en: THE PERSON: once the bearings are found again, people can settle into a strange place.
branches.cn: 人的线：重新找到方位之后，人才能在陌生地方安顿下来。

branches.en: The same turning image links a steering wheel and a business strategy.
branches.cn: 同一个「转向」意象，既连接方向盘，也连接企业战略。

branches.en: Changing a course and helping people adjust both begin with knowing where the east lies.
branches.cn: 改变路线和帮助他人适应，都始于先弄明白东方在哪里。

intro.en: Reorient is built from a Latin prefix, a rising root and a verb ending already present in orient.
intro.cn: reorient 由拉丁语前缀、表示「升起」的词根，以及 orient 中已有的动词词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means again, and oriri, to rise, gives oriens, the rising sun and the east.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 re- 意为「再」，oriri（升起）派生出 oriens，指升起的太阳与东方。

items.example: The prefix re- marks doing the orienting once more.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示把定方向这件事再做一次。

items.example: Oriri describes the sun coming up.
items.exampleCN: oriri 描述太阳升起。

items.example: The ending -ens turns oriri into oriens.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ens 把 oriri 变成 oriens。

items.example: Oriens named the eastern direction for Roman augurs.
items.exampleCN: oriens 曾是罗马占卜者称呼东方的说法。

items.example: Orientare shaped the later English verb.
items.exampleCN: orientare 塑造了后来的英语动词。

items.meaning: to face east, to find your bearings
items.example: Orient works alone and inside reorient.
items.exampleCN: orient 既能单独使用，也存在于 reorient 中。

items.example: A longer form with -ate is orientate.
items.exampleCN: 带 -ate 的较长形式是 orientate。

items.example: The prefix dis- forms disorient.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 dis- 构成 disorient。

items.example: The suffix -ation forms reorientation.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 构成 reorientation。

definition_zh: 重新包装；重新装箱；重新打包；重新搭配或改组一套内容；换一种方式出售成套物品
definition_en: to pack something again, usually in better order or in different containers, and often to rearrange a set of goods, costs or people before offering them again
core_image: 把已经塞满的背包倒出来，按用途一类一类重新装回去
scene: 出发前一晚，孩子把背包里的东西全倒在床上，母亲帮他把衣物、洗漱袋和小药盒一层层码好。Mom repacked the whole bag so that the passport sat at the top.
sceneCN: 这里 repack 是「重新打包、重新装箱」（第 1 个义项：拆开原来的装法，再按新的顺序装好）；句意是母亲把整个包重新收拾了一遍，让护照放在最上面；垫的是重装行李的画面，对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 重新包装；重新装箱；重新打包
重新打点行李；被重新包装（常用于商品说明）

collocations.zh: 把混合物重新压实填料

derivatives.zh: 基础动词加名词后缀 -ing，指重新包装这件工作或这一工序
动词 repackage 加 -ing 构成的名词，指换包装，也常引申为换个说法重新推出
repack 去掉前缀 re- 后的基础动词，表示把东西装进包或箱
与 pack 同族的「包、包装」名词，是 repack 的语义近邻

senses.title: To pack something again
senses.definition: to take what was packed and put it back into a bag, box or case, often in a different order
senses.definitionCN: 把已经装好的东西取出来，再重新装进包、箱或盒子里，通常换一种摆放顺序
senses.example: She repacked her suitcase before leaving the hotel.
senses.exampleCN: 她在离开酒店前把行李箱重新收拾了一遍。
senses.why: The prefix re- means again and pack already means to fill a container, so repack simply repeats the filling action.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 re- 表示「再一次」，pack 本身是「把东西装进去」，两段拼起来就是「再装一次」；重新装的时候自然要先把原来的装法拆开。

senses.title: To redo the load of a container
senses.titleCN: 重新整理容器里的装载
senses.definition: to arrange the contents of a backpack, crate, truck or container again so that the load fits, balances or is easier to reach
senses.definitionCN: 重新安排背包、板条箱、货车或集装箱里的东西，让装载更紧凑、更平衡或更容易拿取
senses.example: The porter repacked the crates so that the top ones would not shift.
senses.exampleCN: 搬运工把箱子重新码了一遍，免得最上面的箱子移位。
senses.why: Since the core image is a full bag being emptied and refilled, the verb easily points at the load itself rather than the things.
senses.whyCN: 核心画面是「塞满的包被倒空再装回去」，所以动作的重心很容易落到「这一整包的装载」上，而不只是里面的单件东西。

senses.title: To put goods into new packaging
senses.definition: to remove products from their packaging and put them into new containers or wrappers for sale or transport
senses.definitionCN: 把商品从原来的包装里取出，换进新的容器或包装材料中，以便出售或运输
senses.example: The factory repacks loose rice into five kilogram bags.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂把散装大米重新分装成五公斤一袋。
senses.why: Once packing means putting goods into packages, repeating it naturally means putting them into different packages.
senses.whyCN: 一旦 pack 指的是「把商品装进包装」，再装一次就是「换成另一种包装」，这是商贸用语里最常见的一路。

senses.title: To sell goods under a new grouping
senses.definition: to combine existing products or services into a different bundle and offer them again
senses.definitionCN: 把现有的产品或服务重新组合成新的套餐，再推向市场
senses.example: The tour company repacked the same hotels as a winter package.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行社把同样的酒店重新组合成一个冬季套餐。
senses.why: A package can be a bundle offered for sale, so repacking means regrouping the contents of that bundle.
senses.whyCN: package 在商业语境里指「成套出售的东西」，重新打包就是把这一套的内容重新搭配，东西没变，卖的卖法变了。

senses.title: To restructure costs or proposals
senses.definition: to record, present or group costs, figures or proposals in a different way without changing what they contain
senses.definitionCN: 不改变实际内容，只换一种方式记录、呈现或归类成本、数字或方案
senses.example: The report repacked the same spending figures into a friendlier chart.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把同样的支出数字重新排进一张更易读的图表。
senses.why: The packing image survives as arrangement, so repacking numbers means rearranging them rather than changing them.
senses.whyCN: 「打包」的核心是「排列方式」，所以把数字重新打包就是把它们换个排法，而不是改动数字本身，这也是财经写作爱用的修辞。

senses.title: To reassemble a team or group
senses.definition: to put together the members of a team, unit or committee again in a new formation
senses.definitionCN: 把团队、部队或委员会的成员重新安排成新的组合
senses.example: The coach repacked the whole squad before the second half.
senses.exampleCN: 教练在半场结束前对整个阵容做了重新组合。
senses.why: People can be packed into a unit just as goods are packed into a crate, so replacing the members repeats the packing.
senses.whyCN: 人也可以像货物装箱那样被「装进」一个编制里，换一批人或换一种摆放就是重新打包，这层用法多出现在体育和军事报道里。

senses.title: To pack a substance down again
senses.titleCN: 重新压实；重新填装填料
senses.definition: to press a material such as soil, gravel or packing material into a space again
senses.definitionCN: 把泥土、碎石或填料这类材料再次压进某个空间里
senses.example: Workers repacked the gravel into the trench after the cable was laid.
senses.exampleCN: 电缆铺好后，工人把碎石重新填回沟里。
senses.why: To pack can mean to press material tightly into a space, so the repeated verb means pressing it in again.
senses.whyCN: pack 还有「把材料压紧、填实」的意思，加上 re- 就变成「再压实一次」，这是工程和农业说明里的具体用法。

senses.title: To pack revised goods for resale
senses.titleCN: 退货或回收后重新包装再卖
senses.definition: to wrap returned, surplus or second hand goods in fresh packaging so that they can be sold again
senses.definitionCN: 把退货、库存或二手货物重新包上新包装，以便再次出售
senses.example: Every returned speaker is tested and repacked before it is listed again.
senses.exampleCN: 每台退回的音箱都要先测试、重新包装，然后才能重新上架。
senses.why: The prefix adds a second round to the whole supply chain, not only to the container, so the verb can mark resale.
senses.whyCN: 这里的「再」不只落在容器上，而是落在整条售卖流程上：退回的商品重走一遍包装，含义就延伸到「退款再售」这一环节。

intro.en: Repack is an English formation made of the prefix re-, meaning again, and the verb pack, whose own origin is uncertain but usually traced through Dutch or Low German.
intro.cn: repack 是英语自己拼出来的词：前缀 re- 表示「再一次」，加上动词 pack。pack 本身的来源不确定，一般认为经中古荷兰语或低地德语进入英语。

items.en: Pack appears in Middle English and is first recorded in the fourteenth century; its origin is uncertain and usually linked to Dutch or Low German pak.
items.cn: pack 在中古英语里已经出现，最早记录约在十四世纪；来源不确定，一般认为与荷兰语或低地德语的 pak 有关，指扎紧的一捆。

items.en: The Latin element re- means back or again, and English has used it to make repeated action verbs since the Middle Ages.
items.cn: 拉丁语要素 re- 表示「回、再一次」，英语自中世纪起就用它造表示重复动作的动词。

items.en: Repack is formed inside English by joining re- to pack, and the first recorded uses concern goods and luggage.
items.cn: repack 是在英语内部由 re- 加 pack 构成的，最早记录下来的用法都与货物和行李有关，一般认为在十八世纪前后进入书面语。

items.en: With the growth of trade, repack spreads into shipping, warehousing and retail descriptions.
items.cn: 随着贸易扩大，repack 进入航运、仓储和零售的描述用语，指换包装后再出货。

items.en: Packing comes to mean bundling files or data, so repacking is used for rebuilding an archive in a different format.
items.cn: pack 在计算机领域指把文件或数据打包，repack 于是被用来表示换一种格式重新打包。

items.en: Today repack covers luggage, goods, bundles, figures and even teams, while repackage has become the usual word for marketing.
items.cn: 如今 repack 覆盖行李、货物、套餐、数字甚至队伍，而营销领域更常用 repackage 这个词。

note.en: Repack sits beside the packing family such as pack, package and unpack, and beside verbs that mean arranging or wrapping goods again.
note.cn: repack 站在 pack、package、unpack 这一族词旁边，也与表示「重新整理」「重新包裹」的动词相邻。

entries.definition: to put things into a container for carrying or storing
entries.definitionCN: 把东西装进容器以便携带或存放；是 repack 去掉前缀后的基础词。

entries.definition: to take things out of a container
entries.definitionCN: 把东西从容器里取出来；与 repack 方向相反，前缀是 un-。

entries.definition: to put something into new packaging, or to present it in a new way
entries.definitionCN: 换包装，也常引申为换个说法重新推出；与 repack 同前缀，但多用在营销语境。

entries.definition: to paint a surface again
entries.definitionCN: 重新刷漆；与 repack 都带 re- 前缀，只是词干不同，并非同源词。

entries.definition: to cover something completely in paper or film
entries.definitionCN: 包裹；把东西整个包在纸或薄膜里，是包装动作最基础的一步。

entries.definition: to put things in a different order
entries.definitionCN: 重新排列；只改顺序，不一定换容器。

entries.definition: to put something into a box again
entries.definitionCN: 重新装箱；把东西取出再装回盒子里。

normalIntro.en: Repack is a plain English sum: re- plus pack, so the picture is always filling a container a second time.
normalIntro.cn: repack 是明明白白的英语加法：re- 加 pack，画面永远是「把容器再装第二遍」。

normal.en: Re- means again, so repack is to pack a second time.
normal.cn: re- 表示「再一次」，所以 repack 就是再装一次。

normal.en: Pack a bag, then repack it when something is missing.
normal.cn: 先装好背包，发现漏了什么就 repack 一遍。

normal.en: Unpack is the reverse verb, and repack undoes it.
normal.cn: unpack 是反向词，repack 正好把 unpack 做的事倒过来重做。

normal.en: Repack the goods means moving them into new packaging.
normal.cn: repack the goods 指把货物换到新的包装里。

normal.en: Compare repackage, which is more common for marketing and rebranding.
normal.cn: 对比 repackage，这个词在营销和改头换面时更常用。

abstract.en: Picture a full backpack emptied onto a bed and refilled in neat layers.
abstract.cn: 想象一只塞满的背包被倒在床上，再一层层码回去。

abstract.en: Think of a shop taking boxes out of old wrapping to make new sets.
abstract.cn: 想象商店拆掉旧包装，把商品重新配成新的套装。

abstract.en: See the same numbers sorted into a cleaner chart.
abstract.cn: 想象同一组数字被排进一张更清爽的图表。

examples.en: He repacked his bag after the bus fare went up.
examples.cn: 车费涨价之后，他把背包重新收拾了一遍。

examples.en: The shop repacks loose nuts into smaller bags for tourists.
examples.cn: 这家店把散装坚果重新装成小袋卖给游客。

examples.en: Everything was unpacked and repacked three times before the move.
examples.cn: 搬家之前，所有东西被拆包又装包了三次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞扒克」——把已经塞满的东西扒出来再克进去，就是重新打包；这只是谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 英语内部构词：前缀 re-（再一次，源自拉丁语）+ 动词 pack（装进容器，来源不确定，一般认为与中古荷兰语或低地德语 pak 有关）；先有 pack，才有 repack。

sensesIntro.en: Repack starts from the physical act of filling a container again, then extends to goods, bundles, figures, teams and the ground itself.
sensesIntro.cn: repack 从「把容器再装一遍」这个物理动作出发，再一步步延伸到货物、套餐、数字、队伍以及压实的材料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an already full bag emptied and filled again in a better order.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只已经装满的包被倒空，再按更好的顺序装回去。

branches.en: Physical repacking covers bags, boxes and whole loads.
branches.cn: 实体意义上的重新打包包括包、箱子以及整车的装载。

branches.en: Packaging and resale make the commercial side of the word.
branches.cn: 换包装与再售构成这个词的商业一面。

branches.en: Regrouping products into a new bundle is the marketing sense.
branches.cn: 把产品重新配成套餐是它的营销义项。

branches.en: Numbers and costs are repacked when only the presentation changes.
branches.cn: 只改呈现方式时，数字与成本就被重新打包。

branches.en: People and materials are packed into a space like goods into a crate.
branches.cn: 人和材料也像货物装箱一样被装进某个空间，对应组编队伍与压实两种用法。

intro.en: Repack is built from the Latin prefix re- and the English verb pack, and around it sit pack, package, unpack and repackage.
intro.cn: repack 由拉丁语前缀 re- 与英语动词 pack 拼成，周围有 pack、package、unpack、repackage 等同一族词。

latinIntro.en: Only the prefix re- is Latin; pack itself is of uncertain, probably Dutch or Low German origin, so the word has no true Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 只有前缀 re- 来自拉丁语，pack 本身来源不确定，一般认为与荷兰语或低地德语有关，因此这个词没有真正的拉丁词根。

items.example: Re- turns pack into repack.
items.exampleCN: re- 把 pack 变成 repack。

items.meaning: to press and tie things into a bundle
items.example: Pack is the base verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: pack 是这一族词的基础动词。

items.meaning: a wrapped parcel or a set of goods sold together
items.example: A package can be a single parcel or a bundle.
items.exampleCN: package 既可以指单个包裹，也可以指一套商品。

items.meaningCN: 表示集合或数量的后缀
items.example: The suffix -age turns pack into package.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -age 把 pack 变成 package。

items.example: Un- makes unpack from pack.
items.exampleCN: un- 由 pack 造出 unpack。

items.meaning: a person or tool that does an action
items.example: The suffix -er forms packer from pack.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 由 pack 造出 packer。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms repacking.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 repacking。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms repacked.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ed 构成 repacked。

items.example: Repack keeps the plain sense of the two parts.
items.exampleCN: repack 保留了前后两部分最直接的意思。

latinEntries.example: Latin re- is productive in verbs like rebuild and return.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 re- 在 rebuild、return 这类动词里很活跃。

latinEntries.example: Iterum is the Latin adverb for again.
latinEntries.exampleCN: iterum 是拉丁语中表示「再一次」的副词。

definition_zh: 重新油漆；重刷；重新绘制；重画；重新涂上一层颜色
definition_en: to paint a surface, a picture or a design again, or to cover an old layer of paint with a fresh one
core_image: 旧墙上的裂纹被一层新漆刷过去，颜色从灰变成亮白
scene: 老屋的墙皮起了皮，工人先刮掉斑驳的旧漆，再把整面墙刷成浅蓝。They repainted the entire facade in one afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 repaint 是「重新粉刷」（第 1 个义项：在原有的旧涂层上再刷一遍，把整面墙覆盖掉）；句意是他们用一个下午把整个外立面重新刷了一遍；画面是旧墙被新漆盖住，对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 重新油漆；重刷；重新绘制；重画
重新刷漆；重画作品（常用于画作修复与游戏图像）

derivatives.zh: 动词加名词后缀 -ing，指重新刷漆或重画这件工作本身
paint 加 work 构成的复合名词，指建筑、车辆或物件表面的漆层
去掉前缀 re- 后的基础动词，指上漆、涂色或作画
paint 加施事后缀 -er，指粉刷匠或画家

senses.title: To paint over an old layer
senses.titleCN: 重新粉刷；在旧漆上再刷一遍
senses.definition: to cover an already painted surface with a new layer of paint
senses.definitionCN: 在已经刷过漆的表面上再刷一层新漆
senses.example: The landlord repainted the flat before the new tenants arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 房东在新房客入住前把公寓重新粉刷了一遍。
senses.why: Re- adds a second round to paint, so the action always starts from a surface that already carries colour.
senses.whyCN: re- 给 paint 加上「第二次」的意味，所以动作总落在本来就有颜色的表面上，画面一定是旧涂层上再盖一层。

senses.title: To redraw a picture or design
senses.definition: to draw or paint a picture, design or lettering again, either to correct it or to make a new version
senses.definitionCN: 把一幅画、一个图案或一组字重新画一遍，或为了改正，或为了做出新版本
senses.example: The designer repainted the logo after the feedback.
senses.exampleCN: 收到反馈后，设计师把标志重画了一遍。
senses.why: Because paint also means to make a picture, the repeated verb works for drawing as well as for walls.
senses.whyCN: paint 除了刷墙还表示「作画」，所以加了 re- 之后也适用于画面上重来一遍，这正是美术与设计领域的常用说法。

senses.title: To restore the paintwork
senses.definition: to apply new paint inside worn areas of an old painting or decorated object during restoration
senses.definitionCN: 在修复过程中，为古老绘画或彩饰器物的缺损处补上新颜料
senses.example: The restorer repainted only the damaged hands of the figure.
senses.exampleCN: 修复师只把塑像受损的双手重新补了色。
senses.why: Restoration repeats a paint layer that once existed, so repaint names the careful filling of missing colour.
senses.whyCN: 修复的本质是把「曾经有过的一层颜料」补回来，所以 repaint 在文物语境里专指局部补色，而不是整面重刷。

senses.title: To make an old object look new
senses.definition: to give an old vehicle, building or product a fresh coat so that it looks newer or better
senses.definitionCN: 给旧车、旧建筑或旧产品刷上新涂层，使外表看起来更新更好
senses.example: The garage repainted the old van and sold it for twice the price.
senses.exampleCN: 车行把旧厢式车重新喷了漆，以两倍的价钱卖了出去。
senses.why: The image of a new colour hiding age easily grows into the idea of cosmetic renewal.
senses.whyCN: 新漆盖住岁月痕迹的画面，很容易延伸为「只翻新外表」的含义，所以这层义项常带一点表面功夫的意味。

senses.title: To paint a different colour
senses.definition: to change the colour of a surface by painting it in a different shade
senses.definitionCN: 用另一种颜色重新涂刷某个表面，从而改变它的色调
senses.example: We repainted the kitchen from yellow to soft green.
senses.exampleCN: 我们把厨房从黄色改刷成了柔和的绿色。
senses.why: A second coat can be a different colour, so repaint often carries the idea of changing rather than restoring.
senses.whyCN: 第二层漆可以是另一种颜色，于是「重刷」会自然带上「更换外观」的意味，这是装修语境中很实用的一层。

senses.title: To change markings on a vehicle
senses.definition: to paint new numbers, names or stripes on a vehicle, aircraft or container, replacing the old markings
senses.definitionCN: 在车辆、飞机或集装箱上涂上新的编号、名称或条纹，覆盖旧标识
senses.example: The taxi was repainted in the colours of the new company.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆出租车被重新喷涂成新公司的涂装。
senses.why: Markings are only paint, so replacing an identity on a vehicle is literally repainting it.
senses.whyCN: 车辆上的标识本来就只是一层漆，所以更换归属或身份时，最直接的写法就是 repaint，这层义项多出现在交通与物流报道中。

senses.title: To repaint a screen image
senses.definition: to draw the graphics of a screen or window again, usually after the content has changed
senses.definitionCN: 在内容发生变化之后，重新绘制屏幕或窗口上的图像
senses.example: The app repaints the window whenever you resize it.
senses.exampleCN: 每当你调整窗口大小，程序就会重绘窗口。
senses.why: Computing borrows the painter image directly: a window is a canvas that is painted again on each change.
senses.whyCN: 计算机直接借用了「作画」的比喻：屏幕就是画布，内容一变就要再画一遍，因此这层义项与「重画」共用同一个核心意象。

senses.title: To add another coat of paint
senses.definition: to apply a further coat so that the surface is even, smooth or completely covered
senses.definitionCN: 再刷一层涂料，使表面均匀、平整或完全覆盖
senses.example: Leave it to dry, then repaint the patch with a roller.
senses.exampleCN: 等它干透以后，再用滚筒把那块地方补刷一遍。
senses.why: A paint job often needs several coats, so the repeated action simply marks the next stage of the work.
senses.whyCN: 刷漆通常要刷好几遍，所以这里的「再刷」只是工序上的下一道，重点不在改变什么，而在把活做完、做匀。

intro.en: Repaint is formed in English from re- and the verb paint, which comes through Old French from Latin pingere, to paint or picture.
intro.cn: repaint 是在英语里由 re- 加动词 paint 构成的。paint 经古法语来自拉丁语 pingere（画、描绘）。

items.en: Pingere means to paint or picture, and its past participle pictus gives English picture and depict.
items.cn: pingere 意为「画、描绘」，过去分词 pictus 又派生出英语的 picture 与 depict。

items.en: The verb peintre and the noun peinture come from pingere and enter English after the Norman conquest.
items.cn: 古法语的动词 peintre 与名词 peinture 都源于 pingere，诺曼征服之后传入英语。

items.en: Paint is recorded in Middle English for both colouring a surface and making a picture.
items.cn: paint 在中古英语里已有记录，既指给表面涂色，也指作画。

items.en: The Latin prefix re- means again or back, and English freely joins it to existing verbs.
items.cn: 拉丁语前缀 re- 表示「再一次、回」，英语常把它直接接到已有动词前面。

items.en: Repaint is recorded in English, first for buildings and pictures that are being done a second time.
items.cn: repaint 在英语里有了记录，最早用于建筑物与绘画的「再做一遍」。

items.en: Software uses repaint for redrawing a screen after the display changes.
items.cn: 软件领域借用 repaint 指画面内容变化后重新绘制屏幕。

note.en: Repaint belongs to the paint family such as painter and paintwork, and sits beside verbs for giving a surface a new finish.
note.cn: repaint 属于 paint、painter、paintwork 这一族词，也与表示「给表面换一层新外观」的动词相邻。

entries.definition: to put colour on a surface or make a picture
entries.definitionCN: 给表面上色或作画；是 repaint 去掉前缀后的基础词。

entries.definition: a person who paints buildings or pictures
entries.definitionCN: 粉刷匠或画家；由 paint 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: to pack something again
entries.definitionCN: 重新打包；与 repaint 同带 re- 前缀，只是词干不同，并非同源构词。

entries.definition: to pay back money or attention
entries.definitionCN: 偿还；回报；读音与拼写都与 repaint 相近，但词干 pay 来自另一条词源。

entries.definition: to apply another coat of paint or varnish
entries.definitionCN: 再涂一层涂层；偏技术用语，强调涂层而不强调颜色。

entries.definition: to paint and furnish a room again
entries.definitionCN: 重新装修；范围比 repaint 大，还包括壁纸、家具等。

entries.definition: to clean and improve an old building or object
entries.definitionCN: 翻新；比 repaint 全面，常包含修理、清洁与更换。

normalIntro.en: Repaint is re- plus paint, so the picture is always a second layer laid over the old one.
normalIntro.cn: repaint 就是 re- 加 paint，画面永远是「在旧的一层上面再盖一层」。

normal.en: Re- means again, so repaint is to paint a second time.
normal.cn: re- 表示「再一次」，所以 repaint 就是再刷一遍。

normal.en: To repaint the walls is to cover the old marks with fresh colour.
normal.cn: repaint the walls 就是用新颜色盖住旧痕迹。

normal.en: The noun repainting names the job of painting again.
normal.cn: 名词 repainting 指「重新刷漆」这项工作。

normal.en: Painters both paint pictures and repaint them.
normal.cn: 画家既 paint 也 repaint 自己的画。

normal.en: Compare redecorate, which covers paint but also furniture and paper.
normal.cn: 对比 redecorate，范围更大，除了刷漆还包括家具和壁纸。

abstract.en: Picture a brush moving over a crack and hiding it in white.
abstract.cn: 想象刷子扫过一道裂缝，把它藏进白色里。

abstract.en: Think of an artist wiping a wrong line and drawing it again.
abstract.cn: 想象画家擦掉画错的一笔，再重新画上。

abstract.en: See an old van rolling out of the garage in bright new colours.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆旧厢式车以崭新的颜色开出车库。

examples.en: They repainted the classroom over the summer holiday.
examples.cn: 他们在暑假期间把教室重新粉刷了一遍。

examples.en: The artist repainted the sky three times before she was happy.
examples.cn: 这位画家把天空重画了三次才满意。

examples.en: The bridge was last repainted in the nineties.
examples.cn: 这座桥上一次重新刷漆是在九十年代。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞喷特」——拿喷枪再喷一遍，就是重新刷漆；这只是谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 pingere（画、描绘）→ past participle pictus → 古法语 peintre / peinture → 英语 paint → 加拉丁语前缀 re-（再一次）构成 repaint。

sensesIntro.en: Repaint moves from painting a wall over again to drawing again, restoring art, renewing looks, changing colour and repainting screens.
sensesIntro.cn: repaint 从「把墙再刷一遍」出发，延伸到重画、修复补色、翻新外表、换颜色以及重绘屏幕。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fresh layer of colour laid over an old one.
core.cn: 核心意象：新的一层颜色盖在旧色之上。

branches.en: Painting a surface again is the plain building sense.
branches.cn: 把表面再刷一遍是最朴素的建筑义项。

branches.en: Drawing again and redrawing a screen share the painter image.
branches.cn: 重画与重绘屏幕都借用了画布的比喻。

branches.en: Restoration fills missing paint in an old picture.
branches.cn: 文物修复中的补色是画作义项的特殊分支。

branches.en: Renewing, recolouring and changing markings all alter the outside.
branches.cn: 翻新、改色与换涂装都在改变外表。

branches.en: Markings on vehicles are literally paint, so changing owners means repainting.
branches.cn: 车上的标识本来就是漆，所以换归属就等于重新喷涂。

intro.en: Repaint is built from the Latin prefix re- and the verb paint, with painter, painting and repainting around it.
intro.cn: repaint 由拉丁语前缀 re- 与动词 paint 拼成，周围有 painter、painting、repainting 等词。

latinIntro.en: The stem goes back to Latin pingere, to paint, through Old French, and the prefix re- is Latin too.
latinIntro.cn: 词干可上溯到拉丁语 pingere（画），经古法语进入英语，前缀 re- 同样来自拉丁语。

items.example: Re- turns paint into repaint.
items.exampleCN: re- 把 paint 变成 repaint。

items.meaning: to put colour on a surface
items.example: Paint is the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: paint 是这一族词的基础。

items.example: Paint plus -er gives painter.
items.exampleCN: paint 加 -er 得到 painter。

items.example: Painting and repainting both use -ing.
items.exampleCN: painting 与 repainting 都用了 -ing。

items.meaningCN: 动作或其结果的名词后缀
items.example: The paint root forms picture through -ure.
items.exampleCN: paint 的词干经 -ure 构成 picture。

items.example: A freshly repainted door is in its new state.
items.exampleCN: 刚刷过漆的门处在完成状态。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms repainted.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ed 构成 repainted。

items.example: Repaint keeps the plain meaning of its parts.
items.exampleCN: repaint 保留了两部分最直接的意思。

latinEntries.example: Pingere is the Latin verb behind paint.
latinEntries.exampleCN: pingere 是 paint 背后的拉丁语动词。

latinEntries.example: Pictus gives English picture and depict.
latinEntries.exampleCN: pictus 派生出英语的 picture 与 depict。

latinEntries.example: Pictura is the Latin noun of the same family.
latinEntries.exampleCN: pictura 是同族的拉丁语名词。

definition_zh: 遣返；把…送回本国；归国；把资金调回本国；把文物归还给原属国
definition_en: to send someone or something back to their own country, and, in finance, to bring money or profits back home
core_image: 一个人在异国的机场门口拎着行李，被送进回国的闸口
scene: 战乱平息后，大使馆派车把滞留的公民送到机场，让他们搭上回国的班机。The government repatriated more than two thousand citizens stranded at the border.
sceneCN: 这里 repatriate 是「遣返回国」（第 1 个义项：把身处外国的人送回自己的国家）；句意是政府把两千多名滞留在边境的公民送回了国；画面是登上归国航班，对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 遣返；把…送回本国；调回（资金）；归还（文物）
被遣返者；归国者（较少用）

derivatives.zh: 动词加名词后缀 -ation，指遣返、归国或调回资金这件过程
加形容词后缀 -able，表示「可被遣返的」
与 patria 同源的名词，指爱国者，核心意象同为「父辈的土地」
前缀换成 ex-（向外），指移居国外者，是 repatriate 的反向同族词

senses.title: To send citizens back home
senses.definition: to send people back to the country they belong to, especially those abroad because of war, disaster or work
senses.definitionCN: 把人送回其所属的国家，尤指因战乱、灾难或工作而身在国外的人
senses.example: The embassy repatriated the students when the epidemic broke out.
senses.exampleCN: 疫情暴发时，大使馆把学生们送回了国。
senses.why: Patria is fatherland, and re- means back, so the verb means to send someone toward the fatherland again.
senses.whyCN: patria 是「父辈的土地」，re- 表示「回」，合起来就是「把人送回父辈的土地」，这是整族词义的出发点。

senses.title: To return home oneself
senses.definition: for a person to return to their own country, often after years abroad
senses.definitionCN: 某人返回自己的国家，常指多年旅居国外之后归来
senses.example: Many graduates chose to repatriate after a decade of work overseas.
senses.exampleCN: 许多毕业生在海外工作了十年之后选择回国。
senses.why: The Latin verb is reflexive as well as transitive, so the same word can describe the person who goes home.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 patriare 本来就有「使回归」与「自返」两面，因此英语里既可以「把别人送回国」，也可以说自己「归国」。

senses.title: To deport people by force
senses.definition: to remove people from a country against their will and return them to their own state
senses.definitionCN: 违背当事人意愿，把人从所在国强制送回其本国
senses.example: Thousands of men were repatriated to their home village against their will.
senses.exampleCN: 成千上万的男子被违背意愿遣返回了家乡。
senses.why: Once the verb is used by officials making a decision for other people, the return becomes compulsory.
senses.whyCN: 当决定权落在官员手里、当事人只能被送回时，「回祖国」就被动成了「驱逐」，这层含义在移民与战争写实报道中最常见。

senses.title: To bring money back home
senses.titleCN: 资金回流；把资金调回本国
senses.definition: to move profits, capital or assets from a foreign country back to the owner own country
senses.definitionCN: 把利润、资本或资产从外国调回所有者本国
senses.example: The new tax rule makes it cheaper to repatriate overseas profits.
senses.exampleCN: 新的税法降低了把海外利润汇回本国的成本。
senses.why: Capital is imagined as an expatriate living abroad, so bringing it home borrows the very same verb.
senses.whyCN: 资本被想象成「旅居海外的人」，把它接回来就借用了同一个词，这也是财经新闻里 repatriate 最高频的用法。

senses.title: To return cultural property
senses.titleCN: 归还文物；返还文化财产
senses.definition: to return stolen or looted cultural objects, artworks or remains to the country they came from
senses.definitionCN: 把掠夺或流失的文物、艺术品或遗骸归还给其原属国家
senses.example: The museum agreed to repatriate several bronze statues.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆同意归还几尊青铜雕像。
senses.why: The object is treated as a person far from home, so giving it back means sending it to its fatherland.
senses.whyCN: 文物被拟人化为「离家在外的成员」，送回去就是让它回到父辈的土地，这层用法近年在归还文物的讨论中很常见。

senses.title: To send remains home
senses.definition: to return the body or remains of someone who died abroad to their own country
senses.definitionCN: 把在国外去世者的遗体或遗骸运回其本国
senses.example: The charity helped repatriate the remains of fallen soldiers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家机构帮助把阵亡士兵的遗骸运回了故乡。
senses.why: Even a body can be sent back to the fatherland, which is why the verb also covers the dead.
senses.whyCN: 连遗体也能被「送回父辈的土地」，所以这个词也被用来描述迁葬与运送阵亡者遗骸，这是新闻中很正式的一层含义。

senses.title: A person who has come back
senses.titleCN: 归国者；被遣返的人（名词用法）
senses.definition: a person who has returned to their own country, used mainly in official and press writing
senses.definitionCN: 已经回到本国的人，主要出现在公文与新闻报道中
senses.example: The repatriates were met by buses and medical staff.
senses.exampleCN: 归国者由大巴和医护人员接待。
senses.why: A verb of movement easily becomes a noun for the people it moves, as with so many English verbs.
senses.whyCN: 英语里表示移动的动词常能直接变成指人的名词，于是 repatriate 也指「被送回的那个人」，多见于公文与新闻。

intro.en: Repatriate joins the prefix re- with a Latin root patra, fatherland, on the model of Latin repatriare, which means to return to one country.
intro.cn: repatriate 是前缀 re- 加上拉丁词根 patra「父辈的土地」构成的，直接模仿拉丁语 repatriare，本义为「回到本国」。

items.en: Patria means the fatherland, from pater, father, and is often used for one native or adopted country.
items.cn: patria 意为「父辈的土地、祖国」，来自 pater（父亲），既指出生的故国，也指入籍后归属的国家。

items.en: Repatriare appears in later Latin with the sense of returning to the fatherland.
items.cn: 较晚的拉丁语里出现 repatriare，意为「回到祖国」，这也是英语词的直接仿造对象。

items.en: Repatriation and repatriate enter English through French usage of the same Latin elements.
items.cn: 一般认为 repatriate 及其名词形式在十七世纪前后经法语进入英语，组成要素仍来自同一套拉丁词。

items.en: Treaties and international law begin to use the word for sending prisoners and displaced persons home.
items.cn: 十九世纪的海约与国际法开始用这个词语表示把战俘和无家可归者送回本国。

items.en: Both world wars spread the term widely for soldiers, refugees and stranded civilians.
items.cn: 两次世界大战让这个词广泛用于士兵、难民和滞留的平民，成为官方文件的固定说法。

items.en: Today the verb also covers money sent back across borders and cultural objects returned to their source countries.
items.cn: 今天的用法还延伸到跨境调回的资金，以及归还给来源国的文物。

note.en: Repatriate is built on the Latin root for fatherland, and sits beside words for sending people home and for life abroad.
note.cn: repatriate 建在表示「父辈的土地」的拉丁词根上，与表示「送人回国」和「旅居国外」的词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of sending people or money back to their own country
entries.definitionCN: 遣返或调回资金的行为；由动词加 -ation 构成的名词。

entries.definition: a person living outside their own country
entries.definitionCN: 移居国外者；同一词根换成表示向外的 ex- 前缀。

entries.definition: a person who loves and defends their country
entries.definitionCN: 爱国者；与 patria 同源，是「爱父辈的土地」的人。

entries.definition: the support or custom given to someone
entries.definitionCN: 光顾或庇护；与 repatriate 拼写相近，但词根是 pater 的「保护人」义，并非「归国」义。

entries.definition: to send a foreigner out of a country by law
entries.definitionCN: 驱逐出境；指把外国人逐出所在国，落脚点是「赶出去」。

entries.definition: to go or send back to a place
entries.definitionCN: 返回；送回；范围最宽，不带「本国」这一限定。

entries.definition: to force someone to leave their country
entries.definitionCN: 放逐；被迫离开本国，与遣返回国的方向相反。

normalIntro.en: Repatriate carries the old word for fatherland, so the image is always being taken back to the land of ones fathers.
normalIntro.cn: repatriate 里藏着「父辈土地」这个古老词，画面永远是「被送回先父之地」。

normal.en: Re- means back and patria means fatherland, so to repatriate is to send home.
normal.cn: re- 表示「回」，patria 表示「父辈的土地」，所以 repatriate 就是送回本国。

normal.en: Expatriate swaps the prefix and lives abroad instead of coming home.
normal.cn: expatriate 换掉前缀，表示人在国外而不是回国。

normal.en: Repatriation names the whole process of coming back.
normal.cn: repatriation 指整个归国或遣返的流程。

normal.en: To repatriate funds is to carry profits back across the border.
normal.cn: repatriate funds 就是把利润跨过边境带回本国。

normal.en: Compare patriot, which shares the very same fatherland root.
normal.cn: 对比 patriot，两者共享同一个「父辈的土地」词根。

abstract.en: Picture a line of passengers stepping into a plane marked for home.
abstract.cn: 想象一队乘客登上一架写着回国的飞机。

abstract.en: See money in a foreign bank rolled away to the home office.
abstract.cn: 想象外国银行里的钱被调回本国的总部。

abstract.en: Think of a bronze statue shipped back to the place it was made.
abstract.cn: 想象一尊青铜像被运回它被铸成的地方。

examples.en: The airline plane repatriated the last group of tourists.
examples.cn: 包机把最后一批游客送回了国。

examples.en: She repatriated from London after twelve years abroad.
examples.cn: 她在国外待了十二年后从伦敦回国。

examples.en: The court ordered the museum to repatriate the carvings.
examples.cn: 法院判令博物馆归还这些雕刻。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞派吹他」——派专机把他吹回老家，就是遣返回国；这只是谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 pater（父亲）→ patria（父辈的土地、祖国）→ 晚期拉丁语 repatriare（回到祖国）→ 英语 repatriate；词根 -patri- 与 patriot、patriotic、expatriate 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Repatriate grows from sending a person back to the fatherland into forced deporting, capital flows, returned cultural property and even remains.
sensesIntro.cn: repatriate 从「把人送回父辈的土地」出发，延伸出强制遣返、资金回流、归还文物甚至运回遗骸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a traveller stepping through the gate that leads home.
core.cn: 核心意象：一位旅人走过那道通往故国的闸口。

branches.en: Sending citizens home and coming home oneself are the two faces of the Latin verb.
branches.cn: 送公民回国与本人归国是同一个拉丁动词的两面。

branches.en: When officials decide, the return becomes forced deportation.
branches.cn: 由官员决定时，回国就变成了强制遣返。

branches.en: Money and profits travel like people and are repatriated as well.
branches.cn: 资金与利润像人一样流动，同样可以被遣返回国。

branches.en: Objects and remains are treated as absent members of the fatherland.
branches.cn: 文物与遗骸被当作父辈土地的缺席成员被送回家。

branches.en: The noun names the people who have just crossed back.
branches.cn: 名词用法指刚刚跨回边境的那些人。

intro.en: Repatriate is re- plus the Latin root for fatherland, and the same root builds patriot, patriotic, expatriate and repatriation.
intro.cn: repatriate 是 re- 加表示「父辈的土地」的词根，同一词根还构成 patriot、patriotic、expatriate 与 repatriation。

latinIntro.en: Latin pater gives patria, fatherland, and later repatriare, to return to the fatherland, which English copied almost exactly.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pater（父亲）派生出 patria（祖国），再派生出 repatriare（回到祖国），英语几乎照搬了这一串。

items.example: Re- marks the return in repatriate.
items.exampleCN: re- 标出 repatriate 里「返回」的方向。

items.example: The root appears in patriot and in repatriate.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根出现在 patriot 与 repatriate 里。

items.example: The ending -ate makes a verb of the stem.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ate 把这个词干变成动词。

items.meaningCN: 动作或过程的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix -ation forms repatriation.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ation 构成 repatriation。

items.example: Ex- makes expatriate from the same root.
items.exampleCN: 同词根的 ex- 构成 expatriate。

items.example: The suffix -able forms repatriable.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 构成 repatriable。

items.example: Patriot shares the fatherland root.
items.exampleCN: patriot 共享「父辈的土地」这一词根。

items.example: Repatriation is the most common derivative.
items.exampleCN: repatriation 是最常见的派生词。

items.meaning: to send back to the fatherland
items.example: Repatriate keeps the Latin sense intact.
items.exampleCN: repatriate 完整保留了拉丁语的本义。

latinEntries.example: Pater is the root of the whole family.
latinEntries.exampleCN: pater 是这一整族词的根。

latinEntries.example: Patria is the direct base of the verb.
latinEntries.exampleCN: patria 是这个词的直接基础。

latinEntries.example: Repatriare already looks like the English word.
latinEntries.exampleCN: repatriare 的形态已与英语词十分接近。

definition_zh: 击退；驱逐；排斥；使人反感；抵御（害虫、水等）
definition_en: to drive something back, keep it away, or make someone feel strong dislike
core_image: 伸出的手掌把逼近的人一把按回去，人群被顶退半步
scene: 拥挤的集市里，一个醉汉突然朝摊位冲过来。The stall holder thrust out both hands to repel the drunk man before he could knock over the fruit.
sceneCN: 这里 repel 是「击退、挡开」（第 1 个义项：用武力把逼近的人逼回去）；句意：摊主伸出双手，在醉汉撞翻水果之前把他挡了回去。

pos.zh: 击退；驱逐；排斥；使人反感

derivatives.zh: repel 加 -ent 构成形容词「令人厌恶的」，再作名词指「驱虫剂」
由动词 repulse 加 -ive 构成，义为「令人反感的」
repel 的同族名词，指「排斥；厌恶」
repulsive 加 -ly 构成，义为「令人厌恶地」

senses.title: To drive back by force
senses.definition: to force an attacker or unwanted force to move back or withdraw
senses.definitionCN: 以武力把进攻者或不受欢迎的力量逼退或赶走
senses.example: The small fleet repelled the invaders within a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这支小型舰队在一周内击退了入侵者。
senses.why: Latin re- pushes back, and pellere means to drive, so the verb literally drives a thing away.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语前缀 re- 表示「往回」，pellere 意为「驱动、推」，字面就是「把东西往回赶」，所以最初指用力把人或攻势推回去。

senses.title: To keep something away
senses.definition: to prevent something from entering or getting close
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某物进入或靠近
senses.example: A thin layer of oil repels water from the surface.
senses.exampleCN: 一层薄油把水挡在了表面之外。
senses.why: Once driving back is done without force, the verb turns into keeping things at bay.
senses.whyCN: 当「往回赶」不必动用武力，动作就变成让东西停在够不着的地方，于是有了「阻隔、不让靠近」的意思。

senses.title: To cause strong dislike
senses.definition: to make someone feel disgust or strong dislike
senses.definitionCN: 使某人产生厌恶或强烈的反感
senses.example: The smell of the chemical repelled the visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 那股化学药品的气味让参观者很不舒服。
senses.why: Dislike acts like a force that pushes a person away, the same backward movement seen in the physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 厌恶在心理上也是一种推力，把人的注意力与好感推离对象，和物理上的「往回赶」是同一个方向。

senses.title: To resist by nature
senses.definition: to resist or fail to absorb something such as water or heat
senses.definitionCN: 抵抗或无法吸收水、热等
senses.example: The new fabric repels rain better than cotton.
senses.exampleCN: 这种新面料比棉布更能防雨。
senses.why: A material that refuses water is repeating the core move of refusing an approaching thing.
senses.whyCN: 材料拒绝水渗进去，就是重复了核心动作：对靠近的东西说「不」。

senses.title: Two things pushing apart
senses.definition: to push two objects or forces away from each other
senses.definitionCN: 把两个物体或力量彼此推开
senses.example: Like poles of two magnets repel each other.
senses.exampleCN: 两块磁铁的同极相互排斥。
senses.why: Physics keeps the literal force meaning and makes it symmetrical, so each object drives the other away.
senses.whyCN: 物理学保留了字面的「力」义，并把它变成对称的：两个物体互相把对方推开。

senses.title: To keep pests away
senses.definition: to keep insects or animals away from a place or a body
senses.definitionCN: 使昆虫或动物远离某地或某人
senses.example: This spray repels mosquitoes for about six hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这种喷雾大约能驱蚊六个小时。
senses.why: The purpose of keeping something away is most familiar in products sold to keep insects off the skin.
senses.whyCN: 「让东西远离」这一用途，最常出现在涂在身上赶走蚊虫的产品上。

senses.title: To refuse an offer
senses.definition: to reject an offer, idea, or approach firmly
senses.definitionCN: 坚决拒绝提议、想法或接近
senses.example: The committee repelled the proposal without discussion.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会未经讨论就否掉了这项提议。
senses.why: A proposal that is driven back never reaches the table, so refusal is the same backward motion in social life.
senses.whyCN: 提议被「赶回去」就进不了议程，所以拒绝是同一个向后动作在社会生活中的版本。

senses.title: To make an argument useless
senses.definition: to prove that an argument or objection is wrong
senses.definitionCN: 证明某个论点或反对意见站不住脚
senses.example: Her figures repelled every objection at the hearing.
senses.exampleCN: 她的数据在听证会上驳倒了所有反对意见。
senses.why: In logic a rebuttal drives an objection back to the speaker, keeping the literal repelling image.
senses.whyCN: 在论辩中，反驳把对方的意见「推回」给提出者，保留了字面的击退意象。

intro.en: Repel comes from Latin repellere, to drive back, formed from re-, back, and pellere, to drive.
intro.cn: repel 来自拉丁语 repellere（赶回、击退），由 re-（向后）与 pellere（推、赶）构成。

items.en: Pellere means to drive, push, or strike, the source of many English verbs.
items.cn: pellere 意为推、赶、驱，是许多英语动词的共同来源。

items.en: Repellere joins re- back with pellere to drive, meaning to drive back.
items.cn: repellere 把 re-（向后）与 pellere（推）合起来，意即赶回去。

items.en: The past participle repulsus, driven back, gives the twin word repulse.
items.cn: 过去分词 repulsus（被赶回的）生出了同族词 repulse。

items.en: Repeller carries the verb into French with the sense of pushing back.
items.cn: repeller 把动词带入法语，保留了「往回推」的意思。

items.en: Middle English repellen first names driving back enemies and forces.
items.cn: 中古英语 repellen 起初指把敌人与军队赶回去。

items.en: Later English extends the word to smells, pests, magnets, and medical ointments.
items.cn: 近代英语又把它扩展到气味、害虫、磁铁与药膏等对象上。

note.en: Repel sits with pellere words such as expel and compel, and with near meaning words about pushing people away.
note.cn: repel 与 expel、compel 等同出 pellere 的词相邻，也与表示「把人推开」的近义词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of driving back or a force that pushes objects apart
entries.definitionCN: 排斥；排斥力；厌恶（与 repel 同出拉丁语 pellere，只是名词形态）

entries.definition: to urge someone to act
entries.definitionCN: 驱使；推动（in- 向内 + pellere 推，推动方向与 repel 相反）

entries.definition: to force someone or something out
entries.definitionCN: 驱逐；开除（ex- 向外 + pellere 推，是「往外推」，与 repel「往回推」方向不同）

entries.definition: to fight against or refuse to accept something
entries.definitionCN: 抵抗；抗拒（强调顶住压力，不强调把对方推回去）

entries.definition: to keep something away by pushing or acting
entries.definitionCN: 挡开；避开（动作更日常，多指用手或言辞挡住）

entries.definition: a strong feeling of dislike
entries.definitionCN: 厌恶（只指心理上的反应，本身不含「击退」的物理动作）

normalIntro.en: Repel is the two handed push: re- sends a thing back, pellere drives it, and together they mean drive it away.
normalIntro.cn: repel 就是双手一推：re- 表示往回，pellere 表示驱赶，合起来就是「往回赶」。

normal.en: Pellere, to drive, also hides in expel and compel, so repel is the backward push of the same family.
normal.cn: pellere（推、赶）也藏在 expel 与 compel 里，所以 repel 是这一词族中方向朝后的那一个。

normal.en: The form repelled doubles the l before the suffix, as in controlled and labelled.
normal.cn: 过去式 repelled 在词尾前双写字母 l，与 controlled、labelled 的规则相同。

normal.en: Repellent is the adjective of something that keeps people or insects away.
normal.cn: repellent 作形容词指「令人厌恶的」，作名词常指「驱虫剂」。

normal.en: Be repelled by means to feel disgust at something.
normal.cn: be repelled by 指对某物感到厌恶。

normal.en: Repulsion is the noun, used for both magnets and feelings.
normal.cn: repulsion 是对应的名词，磁力和情感都用它。

abstract.en: Picture a palm held flat against a crowd that keeps coming.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掌平伸，顶住不断涌来的人群。

abstract.en: Imagine an umbrella shedding every drop that hits it.
abstract.cn: 想象一把伞把打在上面的雨点全部弹开。

abstract.en: Think of two magnets whose ends will not come together.
abstract.cn: 想象两块磁铁，同极怎么也对不到一起。

examples.en: The soldiers held the gate and repelled three attacks in one night.
examples.cn: 士兵们守住城门，一夜之间击退了三次进攻。

examples.en: She was repelled by the cruelty in his voice.
examples.cn: 她被他语气里的残忍激起反感。

examples.en: The coat is treated so that it repels rain and stains.
examples.cn: 这件外套经过处理，能防雨防污。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞波拖瓦」——一伸手，「派」出去的力道又弹回来，把人顶回去：击退、排斥。

root: 拉丁语 repellere「赶回、击退」= re-「向后、往回」+ pellere「推、赶」；同根词有 expel、impel、compel、repulse，词根核心义「朝某个方向用力驱赶」。更早的印欧语来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses of repel all show one force aimed backwards: a body, a bug, a drop, a magnet, an offer, or a rumour is made to go away.
sensesIntro.cn: repel 的八个义项都是同一种朝后的推力：让人、让虫、让水、让磁极、让提议、让观点都退回去。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open palm pushes back a figure that is stepping forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只张开的手掌把正在上前的人顶回去。

branches.en: THE BATTLE: physical force drives an attacker back.
branches.cn: 战场线：以物理力量把进攻者赶回去。

branches.en: THE BARRIER: a surface, a coating, or a spray keeps rain, heat, and insects from getting close.
branches.cn: 屏障线：表面、涂层或喷雾把雨水、热量与昆虫挡在够不着的地方。

branches.en: THE FEELING: dislike behaves like a push that moves a person away from the object.
branches.cn: 心理线：厌恶像一股推力，把人从对象身边推远。

branches.en: THE FORCE: physics names two objects that drive each other apart.
branches.cn: 物理线：物理学用它指两个物体互相推开的力。

branches.en: THE ARGUMENT: an offer or an objection that is driven back never takes hold.
branches.cn: 论辩线：被「推回去」的提议或反对意见都无法生效。

intro.en: Repel is built from the Latin verb pellere, and English keeps the family through re-, ex-, and im- prefixed verbs.
intro.cn: repel 由拉丁语动词 pellere 构成，英语通过 re-、ex-、im- 等前缀保留了这一词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back and pellere means to drive, so repellere means to drive back.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 re- 意为「向后」，pellere 意为「推、赶」，所以 repellere 就是「赶回去」。

items.example: The prefix re- pulls the pushing motion backwards.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 把推动的方向拉回到后面。

items.example: Pellere supplies the force in repel.
items.exampleCN: pellere 为 repel 提供了「用力」的部分。

items.example: Repellere is the direct ancestor.
items.exampleCN: repellere 是直接祖先。

items.example: Repulsus grows into the twin noun repulse.
items.exampleCN: repulsus 发展出同族词 repulse。

items.example: The suffix -ent forms repellent.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ent 构成 repellent。

items.example: The suffix -ive forms repulsive.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ive 构成 repulsive。

items.example: The suffix -ion forms repulsion.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 构成 repulsion。

items.example: Repel keeps the verb sense of the Latin source.
items.exampleCN: repel 保留了拉丁来源的动词义。

items.example: Expel drives out, while repel drives back.
items.exampleCN: expel 是往外赶，repel 是往回赶。

definition_zh: 悔悟；懊悔；忏悔；改悔
definition_en: deep regret for something wrong that one has done, together with a wish to change
core_image: 一个人回过头，看着身后被自己弄坏的东西，手里握着要修补的工具
scene: 半夜的清真寺里，老人迟迟没有离开。He knelt in the dark and prayed for repentance after years of hard words to his brother.
sceneCN: 这里 repentance 是「悔悟、忏悔」（第 1 个义项：对做错的事深感后悔并想改过）；句意：他在黑暗里跪着祈祷，为自己多年来对兄弟说的狠话忏悔。

derivatives.zh: 去掉名词词尾 -ance 得到动词，义为「后悔、悔改」
repent 加 -ant 构成形容词，义为「悔悟的、懊悔的」
加否定前缀 un- 而成，义为「不知悔改的」

senses.title: Deep regret for a wrong
senses.definition: sorrow felt for having done something wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因做了错事而感到的深切后悔
senses.example: She spoke with real repentance about the lie.
senses.exampleCN: 她谈起那次说的谎话时流露出真心的悔意。
senses.why: Latin poenitere means to be sorry, and the -ance noun names the inner state of that sorrow.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 poenitere 意为「感到后悔」，加 -ance 构成的名词指这种心中后悔的状态本身。

senses.title: A turning away from the fault
senses.definition: a change of mind that turns a person away from the wrong path
senses.definitionCN: 改变心意，从错误的道路上转回来
senses.example: His repentance showed in the letters he wrote to every customer he had cheated.
senses.exampleCN: 他的悔改体现在他给每位被他欺骗的顾客写的信里。
senses.why: The verb behind the noun was rethought in Latin as a change of mind, so the state turns into a direction: away from the wrong.
senses.whyCN: 词源上的动词在拉丁语里被理解成「改变心意」，于是这种状态带上了方向：离开错误的那一边。

senses.title: An outward confession
senses.definition: a public or religious admission of sin with sorrow
senses.definitionCN: 公开或宗教意义上带着悲伤承认罪过
senses.example: The priest asked her to speak words of repentance before the whole congregation.
senses.exampleCN: 神父请她在全体会众面前说出忏悔的话。
senses.why: A feeling that stays private becomes a religious act that must be said aloud.
senses.whyCN: 原本私密的情感要按规定说出来，就变成了宗教仪式中的「忏悔」。

senses.title: Apology by a community or state
senses.definition: an official expression of regret by a group or a state
senses.definitionCN: 团体或国家对过去错误作出的正式悔过表示
senses.example: The report called for national repentance over the land seizures.
senses.exampleCN: 报告呼吁国家就当年的土地强占作出悔过。
senses.why: When the wrongdoer is a whole institution, the feeling is spoken by a government instead of one person.
senses.whyCN: 当犯错的是一个机构乃至国家时，这种情感就由政府代为表达，而不再是个人。

senses.title: Unwanted change of heart
senses.definition: a choice one is forced to make and will later feel sorry about
senses.definitionCN: 被迫做出、事后多半会后悔的选择
senses.example: Buying that plot at that price felt like money bought with repentance.
senses.exampleCN: 以那个价格买下那块地，像是用后悔换来的钱。
senses.why: Older English used the word for a change of mind one is sorry to make, a narrow surviving sense of the same root.
senses.whyCN: 早期英语曾用它指「不得不做、日后会后悔的改变」，这是同一词根下很小的一条保留义。

intro.en: Repentance goes back to Latin paenitere, to be sorry, through Old French repentance; its spelling with re- was reshaped in later times.
intro.cn: repentance 上溯拉丁语 paenitere（感到后悔），经古法语 repentance 进入英语；现在拼写中的 re- 是后来的改写。

items.en: Paenitere means to be sorry, and the noun paenitentia means sorrow for a fault.
items.cn: paenitere 意为「感到后悔」，名词 paenitentia 指对过失的悔意。

items.en: Christian writers develop the idea into a turning away from sin.
items.cn: 基督教作家把这一概念发展为「从罪中转离」。

items.en: Repentir and repentance carry the religious sense into French.
items.cn: repentir 与 repentance 把宗教含义带入法语。

items.en: Repentance appears in Middle English religious writing.
items.cn: repentance 在中古英语宗教文献中出现。

items.en: The word widens beyond religion to any regret for wrong, while its cousins penitence and penance stay close to church use.
items.cn: 近现代英语里它超出宗教范围，泛指对过错的后悔；而同族词 penitence 与 penance 仍多留在教会语境中。

note.en: Repentance shares its stem with repent and repentant, and stands next to remorse and penitence in the field of regret.
note.cn: repentance 与 repent、repentant 同词干，在「后悔」义场中与 remorse、penitence 相邻。

entries.definition: to feel sorry for something wrong that one has done
entries.definitionCN: 后悔；悔改（去掉 -ance 的动词形态）

entries.definition: showing that one is sorry for a fault
entries.definitionCN: 悔悟的；懊悔的（加 -ant 的形容词形态）

entries.definition: not feeling sorry for a wrong
entries.definitionCN: 不知悔改的（加否定前缀 un- 的形态）

entries.definition: a painful memory of guilt for a wrong act
entries.definitionCN: 懊悔；自责（侧重持续的痛苦感，不含「改过」的行动）

entries.definition: sorrow shown for a wrong, often in religion
entries.definitionCN: 忏悔；悔罪（更偏宗教场合，词形不同但义场相同）

entries.definition: deep and sincere regret for sin
entries.definitionCN: 痛悔（语气最重，多用于宗教文本）

normalIntro.en: Repentance is the noun of turning back: a person looks at the damage and wants to stop being the one who caused it.
normalIntro.cn: repentance 是「回头」的名词：人看着造成的损害，不想再做那个造成损害的人。

normal.en: The -ance ending turns the verb repent into a lasting state rather than a single act.
normal.cn: -ance 词尾把动词 repent 变成状态名词，强调的是一种持续存在的心态，而不是一次性的动作。

normal.en: Repentance pairs with true and deep to show how sincere the sorrow is.
normal.cn: repentance 常与 true、deep 搭配，用来表明后悔的真诚程度。

normal.en: Repentant is the adjective for someone who shows this sorrow.
normal.cn: repentant 是形容词，指表现出这种悔意的人。

normal.en: Unrepentant adds un- and means refusing to feel sorry.
normal.cn: unrepentant 加上了否定前缀 un-，表示「拒不悔改」。

normal.en: The religion words penitence and penance belong to the same Latin family.
normal.cn: 宗教用词 penitence 与 penance 来自同一拉丁词族。

abstract.en: Picture a traveller who looks back at the road he broke.
abstract.cn: 想象一位旅人回头望着被自己踩坏的路。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand that puts back a borrowed book and stays to mend its torn page.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把借走的书放回去，还留下来粘补撕破的那页。

abstract.en: Think of a door swung open backwards, so the room is lit again.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门向后打开，屋子重新亮了。

examples.en: True repentance means more than saying sorry.
examples.cn: 真正的悔改不只是说一句对不起。

examples.en: The letters from the local churches asked for repentance and forgiveness.
examples.cn: 当地教会来信，请人悔过并寻求宽恕。

examples.en: There was no sign of repentance in him after the accident.
examples.cn: 事故之后，他毫无悔意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「日喷炭斯」——一边喷着粗气一边收拾炭灰，事后才知道后悔：悔悟、忏悔。

root: 拉丁语 paenitere「感到后悔」→ paenitentia「悔意」→ 古法语 repentance → 英语 repentance；同族词 penitence、penance 也出自 paenitentia。拼写中的 re- 为后世改写，并非表「再」的前缀义。更早的印欧语来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Repentance starts as an inner sorrow, then becomes a direction away from the wrong, then an act said aloud, and then a word a whole society can use.
sensesIntro.cn: repentance 先是一种心中的悲伤，再变成离开错误的方向，然后变成说出口的举动，最后成为整个社会都能使用的词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person turns round and looks steadily at the damage he has caused.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人转过身，久久地看着自己造成的损害。

branches.en: THE FEELING: sorrow is the first and most personal layer.
branches.cn: 情感线：悲伤是最私密、最基本的一层。

branches.en: THE DIRECTION: the feeling hardens into a decision to stop.
branches.cn: 方向线：情感凝结为「停止」的决定。

branches.en: THE ACT: the sorrow is spoken in public and in religion.
branches.cn: 行动线：悲伤被公开说出，进入宗教场景。

branches.en: THE INSTITUTION: a government can speak the words for a whole nation.
branches.cn: 制度线：政府可以替整个国家说出这些话。

branches.en: THE NARROW SENSE: a change one is forced to make and later regrets.
branches.cn: 窄义线：被迫做出、日后后悔的改变。

intro.en: Repentance is a Latin verb turned into a state noun, and its English relatives depend on -ance, -ant, and un-.
intro.cn: repentance 是拉丁语动词变成的状态名词，它的英语亲属主要靠 -ance、-ant 与否定前缀 un- 构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin paenitere means to be sorry, and paenitentia means sorrow for a fault.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 paenitere 意为「感到后悔」，paenitentia 意为「对过失的悔意」。

items.example: Paenitere supplies the root of the family.
items.exampleCN: paenitere 提供了整个词族的词根。

items.example: Paenitentia is the direct Latin source of the state.
items.exampleCN: paenitentia 是这一状态义的直接拉丁来源。

items.example: Paenitens grows into English penitent.
items.exampleCN: paenitens 发展出英语 penitent。

items.example: The suffix -ance makes repentance a noun of state.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ance 把 repentance 变成状态名词。

items.example: The suffix -ant forms repentant.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ant 构成 repentant。

items.example: The prefix un- forms unrepentant.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 un- 构成 unrepentant。

items.meaning: an act done to show sorrow
items.example: Penance is cousin of the same Latin noun.
items.exampleCN: penance 是同一拉丁名词的堂亲。

items.example: Penitence keeps the Latin noun form almost intact.
items.exampleCN: penitence 几乎原样保留了拉丁名词形态。

items.meaning: to feel sorry and turn from a fault
items.example: Repent is the short verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: repent 是这个词族中的短动词。

definition_zh: 全部曲目；保留剧目；（技能、手段）全部储备；生物体的反应类型总数
definition_en: all the works, skills, or means that a performer, a place, or a living thing has ready to use
core_image: 舞台侧边打开一只大号谱夹，里面整整齐齐插满可以随时上场的节目单
scene: 剧院后台，墙上贴着一整年的演出海报。The small troupe built its repertoire from folk songs and one modern play.
sceneCN: 这里 repertoire 是「保留剧目、常演曲目」（第 1 个义项：一个团体能够随时演出的作品总和）；句意：这个小剧团把民谣和一部现代剧编成了自己的保留剧目。

pos.zh: 保留剧目；全部曲目；（技能与手段的）全部储备；反应类型总数

collocations.zh: 丰富的保留曲目；广泛的储备
积累剧目；积累技能储备

derivatives.zh: 同源拼写变体，义为「保留剧目；剧目轮演」
由 repertoire 加 building 构成的复合词，指「扩充剧目的过程」

senses.title: The works a performer can offer
senses.definition: all the pieces that a performer or group is ready to perform
senses.definitionCN: 表演者或团体能够随时演出的全部作品
senses.example: The cellist has added ten new pieces to her repertoire.
senses.exampleCN: 这位大提琴手给她的曲目单新增了十首曲子。
senses.why: Latin repertorium means a list or an index, and a list of pieces is exactly what a performer keeps backstage.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 repertorium 意为「清单、索引」，而每位表演者后台留着的那份东西，正是一张作品清单。

senses.title: The plays a company keeps
senses.definition: the plays or shows that a theatre company keeps available to stage
senses.definitionCN: 剧团长期保留、随时可以上演的戏剧或节目
senses.example: That comedy has entered the company repertoire.
senses.exampleCN: 那出喜剧已经成了剧团的保留剧目。
senses.why: A theatre needs a supply of shows that can be revived at short notice, so the performers list becomes a company list.
senses.whyCN: 剧团需要一批能随时复排的戏，于是表演者的那份清单变成了剧团的清单。

senses.title: The range of methods and skills
senses.definition: the set of skills, tricks, or methods a person has ready
senses.definitionCN: 一个人随时可用的一整套技能、技巧或手段
senses.example: A good teacher has a repertoire of ways to explain a hard idea.
senses.exampleCN: 好老师手里有一整套讲清难点的办法。
senses.why: Once a list can name works, it can name any ready arsenal, from a teachers methods to a politicians promises.
senses.whyCN: 清单既然可以列出作品，也就能列出任何一种现成的资源库：老师的方法，或者政治人物的承诺。

senses.title: Total possible actions in biology
senses.definition: the total number of behavioural or immune responses a living thing can make
senses.definitionCN: 生物体能够作出的全部行为或免疫反应种类
senses.example: Mice have a wider repertoire of alarm calls than was once believed.
senses.exampleCN: 老鼠的警报叫声种类比过去认为的更丰富。
senses.why: Biologists took the word for the full set of available responses, counting what a body can still do rather than what it has done.
senses.whyCN: 生物学家借这个词表示全部可用反应，统计的不是已经做出的反应，而是身体还能做出的反应。

senses.title: Supplies kept ready for use
senses.definition: a stock of supplies kept ready for future use
senses.definitionCN: 留待日后使用的物资储备
senses.example: The hospital keeps a repertoire of dressings in every ward.
senses.exampleCN: 医院在每个病区都留有一批敷料备用。
senses.why: The oldest layers of the Latin noun already meant a store of things kept at hand, and supplies fit that image without any change.
senses.whyCN: 这一拉丁名词最古老的含义本就是「手边留存的物品」，物资储备完全契合，无需任何改变。

senses.title: The list itself
senses.definition: a list or catalogue, the oldest sense of the Latin source
senses.definitionCN: 一份清单或目录，即拉丁语来源最初的含义
senses.example: The manuscript begins with a repertoire handed down from a printer.
senses.exampleCN: 这份抄本以一张从印刷商那里传下来的索引开头。
senses.why: The list itself survives as the last sense, a reminder that every later meaning grew from a written index.
senses.whyCN: 清单本身作为最后一个义项保留下来，提醒人后来的每个含义都从一份书面索引长出。

intro.en: Repertoire is the French form of Latin repertorium, a list or index, which comes from reperire, to find.
intro.cn: repertoire 是法语中的拉丁语 repertorium（清单）形式，源于 reperire（重新找到），由 re- 与 parire（产出）构成。

items.en: Parire means to bring forth, and the compound reperire means to find.
items.cn: parire 意为「产出、带来」，复合词 reperire 意为「找到」。

items.en: Repertorium means a list, an index, or a store of information.
items.cn: repertorium 意为清单、索引，或可供查阅的资料汇编。

items.en: Repertoire carries the list meaning into French, used for contents of books and papers.
items.cn: repertoire 把「清单」的含义带入法语，用于书刊与文书的目录。

items.en: In the theatre the word names the set of works an actor or company can play.
items.cn: 在剧院术语中，这个词被用来指演员或剧团能够上演的全部作品。

items.en: English borrows the word in its French spelling, first for theatre and music.
items.cn: 英语在近代借入这个词，保留其法语拼写，起初用于戏剧与音乐。

items.en: English widens it to skills, equipment, and the responses of living things.
items.cn: 二十世纪以后，英语把它扩展到技能、装备以及生物的反应上。

note.en: Repertoire is close in spelling to repertory, its English variant, and near in meaning to vocabulary and range words.
note.cn: repertoire 与它的英语变体 repertory 拼写相近，在意义上也与 vocabulary、range 一类词相邻。

entries.definition: the English variant, used for plays kept for regular performance
entries.definitionCN: 同源拼写变体（英式常用），尤指可以轮演保留的剧目

entries.definition: the act of doing something again, with a different root
entries.definitionCN: 重复（拼写开头相近，词源不同：它来自拉丁语 repetere「再次寻求」）

entries.definition: a frequently seen misspelling of repertoire, with t for r
entries.definitionCN: 常见的错拼形式：把字母 r 误写成 t（与目标词并非同源，只是拼写相近）

entries.definition: the full set of things of one kind that are available
entries.definitionCN: 范围；全部种类（更泛，不含「可以演出」的行业色彩）

entries.definition: goods kept ready for sale or use
entries.definitionCN: 存货；储备（多指实物，不指技能与节目）

entries.definition: a complete list of things held
entries.definitionCN: 清单；存货目录（与 repertoire 最初「清册」的含义相通）

normalIntro.en: Repertoire is a list of everything one can pull out and use: songs, plays, tricks, or, in biology, ready responses.
normalIntro.cn: repertoire 是一张「随时可以拿出来用」的清单：歌、戏、技巧，或在生物学里指现成的反应。

normal.en: The word comes from Latin repertorium, a list or index, so a repertoire is a list first, a skill set second.
normal.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 repertorium（清单、索引），所以「清册」是它的本义，「本事」是引申义。

normal.en: Repertory is the spelling used more in British English and in the phrase repertory theatre.
normal.cn: repertory 更多见于英式英语，也常出现在「轮演剧团」这一说法里。

normal.en: A wide repertoire means both many pieces and many abilities.
normal.cn: a wide repertoire 既可以说曲目多，也可以说本事多。

normal.en: The plural is repertoires, with no accent on the final -e.
normal.cn: 复数形式是 repertoires，词尾的字母 e 不发音，也不带重音。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with repettoire, which simply misses an r.
normal.cn: 注意别把中间的字母 r 丢掉或写成 t，这是一个常见的拼写失误。

abstract.en: Picture a music stand folder that swings open over the stage.
abstract.cn: 想象一只谱夹在舞台边打开，页页都是待演出的节目。

abstract.en: Imagine a magicians case, each pocket holding one ready trick.
abstract.cn: 想象一只魔术箱，每个口袋都放着一招现成的戏法。

abstract.en: Think of a chef who can cook twenty dishes without looking at a book.
abstract.cn: 想象一位厨师不看菜谱就能做出二十道菜。

examples.en: The orchestra added several new works to its repertoire this season.
examples.cn: 乐团本季在保留曲目中新增了几部作品。

examples.en: Good managers build a repertoire of ways to handle sudden delays.
examples.cn: 好的管理者会积累一整套应对突发延误的办法。

examples.en: Researchers also use a repertoire in biology for the total possible responses.
examples.cn: 在生物学中，该词也被用来指全部可能的反应种类。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「rep 拖瓦」——演员把「rep」的节目一遍遍拖着排，瓦片大的节目单贴满后台：保留曲目、全部储备。

root: 拉丁语 reperire「找到、寻获」= re-「再、回」+ parire「产出、带来」；由它派生的 repertorium「清单、索引」经法语作 repertoire 进入英语，本义「清册」，后专指可随时上演的作品，再引申为技能与反应的全套储备。parire 更早的印欧语来源一般认为与「生育、产生」相关。

sensesIntro.en: The six senses move from one performer list to a company stage list, then to a persons methods, a living organisms responses, a store of supplies, and finally back to the plain list.
sensesIntro.cn: repertoire 的六个义项由一份表演者的曲目单，转到剧团的剧目单，再到一个人的方法库、生物的反应类型、备用的物资，最后回到最朴素的「清单」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a folder of ready works, opened beside the stage.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只装满现成作品的谱夹，在舞台边打开。

branches.en: THE STAGE: what a single artist or a whole company can perform on demand.
branches.cn: 舞台线：一位艺术家或整个剧团随时能上演的东西。

branches.en: THE PERSON: the same idea moves from music to methods and skills.
branches.cn: 个人线：同一想法由音乐转到方法与技能上。

branches.en: THE BODY: biology counts the responses a creature can give.
branches.cn: 身体线：生物学统计一个生物能给出的反应种类。

branches.en: THE STORE: supplies kept ready are a repertoire in the oldest sense of a reserve.
branches.cn: 储备线：留作备用的物资，是「储备」这一古老含义的延续。

branches.en: THE LIST ITSELF: the original list meaning still underlies the modern theatre sense.
branches.cn: 清单线：最初的「清单」义并为现代剧院义项的底座。

intro.en: Repertoire is built on Latin parire and its compound reperire, and English keeps the family through -orium and -ory endings.
intro.cn: repertoire 建立在拉丁语 parire 及其复合词 reperire 上，英语通过 -orium 与 -ory 这类词尾保留了这一词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin reperire means to find, and repertorium means a list or index of things found.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 reperire 意为「找到」，repertorium 意为找到之物的清单或索引。

items.example: The prefix re- gives the sense of finding again.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 带来「再次找到」的意味。

items.example: Parire supplies the producing image in reperire.
items.exampleCN: parire 为 reperire 提供了「产出」的意象。

items.example: Reperire is the verb behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: reperire 是整个词族背后的动词。

items.example: Repertorium is the direct source of the list sense.
items.exampleCN: repertorium 是「清单」义的直接来源。

items.meaningCN: 表示场所或汇集之物的词尾
items.example: The suffix -orium marks a collection.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -orium 表示汇集之物。

items.meaningCN: 表示场所或集合的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ory forms repertory.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ory 构成 repertory。

items.meaning: a store or list of works
items.example: Repertory is the native English twin.
items.exampleCN: repertory 是英语本土的双胞胎形式。

items.example: Latin thesaurus means a treasury, a near cousin in idea.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 thesaurus 意为宝库，在概念上是近亲。

definition_zh: 重复的；啰唆的；反复出现的；单调乏味的
definition_en: repeating or containing a lot of repetition, often so often that it becomes tiresome
core_image: 同一句话被一遍又一遍念出来，听者开始打哈欠
scene: 会议纪要里同一个数据被抄来抄去，读的人越读越烦。The report was cancelled simply because the wording was repetitious.
sceneCN: 这里 repetitious 是「重复啰唆的」（第 2 个义项，指内容反复、让人厌烦）；句意为这份报告被取消，原因仅仅是措辞重复啰唆。

pos.zh: 形容词：重复的；反复出现的；啰唆的；单调乏味的

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 repetitio 直接进入英语，义为「重复；反复」
同族基础动词，义为「重复；再说一遍」
由 repeat 加 -itive 构成，义为「重复性的；反复的」
由 repeat 加形容词后缀构成，义为「可重复的；可复现的」
由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「重复地；反复地」

senses.title: Said or done again and again
senses.titleCN: 反复进行的；一遍又一遍的
senses.definition: happening or being done many times over, the same way each time
senses.definitionCN: 以相同方式反复发生或反复做
senses.example: The early lessons rely on repetitious drills.
senses.exampleCN: 早期的课程依靠反复操练。
senses.why: The adjective is built on Latin repetere, to go back to and fetch again; its core image is the same act coming round a second time and then a third.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词由拉丁语 repetere（再回去、再取一次）构成；核心意象是同一个动作一轮接一轮地回来。

senses.title: Tiresomely repeated
senses.titleCN: 重复而啰唆的；让人厌烦的
senses.definition: full of unnecessary repetition, so that it becomes boring to read or hear
senses.definitionCN: 充满不必要的重复，读起来或听起来让人厌烦
senses.example: His speech was repetitious and hard to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 他的演讲重复啰唆，让人难以听出重点。
senses.why: The suffix -itious adds the notion of being full of something; once a text is full of repeats, the listener feels the weight of each extra round.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -itious 表示「充满……」，当文本塞满重复，听的人就感到每一轮多余都压在耳边。

senses.title: Showing repetitive patterns
senses.titleCN: 有重复规律的；呈重复模式的
senses.definition: showing a regular pattern in which the same elements keep coming back
senses.definitionCN: 呈现出同样要素不断回返的规律，例如艺术、设计或行为中的重复纹样与程式
senses.example: The wallpaper has a repetitious floral pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 墙纸上有重复的花卉图案。
senses.why: Neutral use keeps only the regular return: the design, the rhythm or the habit simply comes back on a fixed beat.
senses.whyCN: 中性用法只保留「规律性回返」这一层：图案、节奏或习惯按固定的节拍回来。

senses.title: Repeating oneself in speech
senses.titleCN: 言语唠叨的；翻来覆去地说的
