senses.definition: describing a person or a way of speaking that keeps saying the same thing
senses.definitionCN: 形容人说话反复，不断把同一件事再说一遍
senses.example: The old coach grew repetitious about the same old complaint.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老教练对同一个旧抱怨翻来覆去地说。
senses.why: A speaker is called repetitious when the second and third telling add nothing new, only the memory of the first.
senses.whyCN: 当第二次、第三次讲述没有带来新信息，只带回第一次的记忆时，说话者就被形容为 repetitious。

senses.title: Monotonous and dull
senses.titleCN: 单调乏味的；一成不变的
senses.definition: so unchanging that it is dull and lacks variety
senses.definitionCN: 一成不变，缺少变化而显得乏味
senses.example: Long repetitious shifts left the workers exhausted.
senses.exampleCN: 漫长而单调的轮班让工人们疲惫不堪。
senses.why: Many neutral repeats slide into a wearisome uniformity, so the word can describe anything dull through sameness.
senses.whyCN: 大量中性的重复会滑向令人厌倦的千篇一律，所以这个词也能形容任何因雷同而乏味的事物。

senses.title: In a repetitious manner
senses.titleCN: 重复地；啰唆地（副词用法）
senses.definition: an adverb form meaning in a repeating, over-and-over way
senses.definitionCN: 副词形式，表示以反复、一遍又一遍的方式
senses.example: The clerk typed the address repetitiously, line by line.
senses.exampleCN: 职员逐行、反复地输入同一个地址。
senses.why: The adverb simply attaches the -ly to the adjective and puts the repeated rhythm onto a verb.
senses.whyCN: 副词只是给形容词加上 -ly，把重复的节奏附着到某个动词上。

senses.title: Overused and worn out
senses.definition: saying or phrasing that has been worn out by too much use
senses.definitionCN: 因使用过多而变得陈旧的说法或表达
senses.example: His writing sinks into repetitious slogans.
senses.exampleCN: 他的文字滑入陈旧的标语。
senses.why: A repeated phrase loses its flavour in each reuse; repetition is the mechanism that wears an expression down.
senses.whyCN: 一个说法每被再用一次就流失一分味道，重复正是让表达被磨旧的过程。

senses.title: Repetitious versus repetitive
senses.titleCN: repetitious 与 repetitive 的分工
senses.definition: the usage distinction that pairs repetitious with tedium and repetitive with structural recurrence
senses.definitionCN: 用法上的分工：repetitious 多带「令人厌烦」，repetitive 多指结构性的反复
senses.example: Repeated movement is best called repetitive work.
senses.exampleCN: 重复性的动作最好用 repetitive work 来表达。
senses.why: Both words descend from the same Latin verb, yet English gives repetitious the heavier, complaining tone and keeps repetitive for plain recurrence.
senses.whyCN: 两个词出自同一个拉丁动词，但英语让 repetitious 带上更重的抱怨口吻，把 repetitive 留给单纯的结构性反复。

intro.en: Repetitious descends from Latin repetere, to seek again, through repetitio, a repeating.
intro.cn: repetitious 源自拉丁语 repetere（再寻求、再取回），经 repetitio（重复）而来。

items.en: Repetere means to seek again, go back to, or fetch back; re- adds again and petere means to seek or aim at.
items.cn: repetere 意为再寻求、再回去或再取回；re- 加「再」，petere 意为求取、朝向。

items.en: Repetere also developed the sense of saying or doing something over again, which is the sense English inherited.
items.cn: repetere 还发展出「重新说一遍或做一遍」的含义，英语继承的正是这一层。

items.en: The noun repetitio means a repetition or a taking up again, and it is the base of the adjective family.
items.cn: 名词 repetitio 意为重复或重新拾起，是这组形容词的基础。

items.en: Old French repeticion and the learned Latin forms passed the noun repetition into Middle English.
items.cn: 古法语 repeticion 与学府拉丁语的词形把重复这一名词带入中古英语。

items.en: The adjective repetitious is recorded by the mid seventeenth century; its exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 形容词 repetitious 约在十七世纪中叶有记录；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: English later formed repetitive from repeat, and the two adjectives now divide the work of describing recurrence.
items.cn: 英语后来又从 repeat 造出 repetitive，这两个形容词如今分工描述反复。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on Latin petere, to seek; the near-meaning group gathers words about doing or saying things again.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语 petere（求取）构成的一族词；近义组收表示「再做一次、再说一遍」的词，语气强弱不同。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of saying or doing something again, or for something that recurs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「重复、反复」，指重新说或重新做的行为，也指再次出现之物。

entries.definition: The adjective from repeat, meaning happening again in a similar way, usually neutral in tone.
entries.definitionCN: 由 repeat 派生的形容词，义为「重复性的」，语气通常中性，比 repetitious 少一层厌烦。

entries.definition: To try to win or do better than others; it shares Latin petere but has no idea of repeating.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「竞争、比赛」，同出拉丁语 petere，但不含重复之义；与 repetitious 只是同根不同支。

entries.definition: Unnecessary because it repeats what is already there.
entries.definitionCN: 因重复已有内容而多余的，比 repetitious 更直接点出「多余」。

entries.definition: Never changing and therefore dull; it stresses sameness of tone rather than overt repetition.
entries.definitionCN: 一成不变而沉闷的，强调语调雷同本身，而不强调重复的动作。

entries.definition: Long, slow and boring; it stresses the exhaustion of the listener rather than the cause.
entries.definitionCN: 冗长乏味的，强调听者或读者的疲惫感，而不必指明重复这一原因。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root petere, to seek, and the suffixes that turn a noun into an adjective.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁词根 petere（求取），以及把名词变成形容词的后缀。

normal.en: Re- means again and petere means to seek, so to repeat is to go and fetch the same thing again.
normal.cn: re- 表示「再」，petere 表示「求取」，所以重复就是再去把同一样东西取回来。

normal.en: The noun repetition and the adjective repetitious share the same stem repetit-, and the -ous suffix means full of.
normal.cn: 名词 repetition 与形容词 repetitious 共享词干 repetit-，后缀 -ous 意为「充满」。

normal.en: The suffix -itious adds the idea of being full of something, so repetitious is repetition in quantity.
normal.cn: 后缀 -itious 带「充满」之意，所以 repetitious 指的是重复量大。

normal.en: Repetitive is built on repeat and stays neutral, while repetitious usually carries a complaint.
normal.cn: repetitive 由 repeat 派生，语气中性；repetitious 通常带抱怨意味。

normal.en: The same Latin petere gives compete and appetite, none of which keeps the idea of repetition.
normal.cn: 同一个拉丁词 petere 还给出 compete 与 appetite，它们都不含重复之义。

abstract.en: Picture a hand reaching back to the same shelf for the same jar, again and again.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手一次又一次伸回同一层架子，去拿同一个罐子。

abstract.en: Hear the same sentence three times: the second telling adds nothing, and the third only adds weight.
abstract.cn: 听同一句话三遍：第二遍什么都没添，第三遍只是多了一层沉重感。

abstract.en: Watch a wallpaper pattern tile across a wall: each tile is the same, and the wall becomes one long repeat.
abstract.cn: 看墙纸图案一格格铺满整面墙：每格都一样，整面墙成了一段长长的重复。

examples.en: The lecture grew repetitious as the speaker circled the same point.
examples.cn: 讲者反复绕回同一个要点，讲座变得啰唆起来。

examples.en: Editors cut repetitious sentences to keep the article tight.
examples.cn: 编辑删去重复啰唆的句子，让文章紧凑。

examples.en: Good music can be built on repetitious phrases without becoming boring.
examples.cn: 好的音乐可以建立在重复的乐句上，却并不令人乏味。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞皮替舍斯」——替他说了又替他说，反复拉扯；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再、回）+ petere（寻求、朝……去）→ repetere（再取回、再说一遍）→ 名词 repetitio → 英语 repetition，再由同一词干加后缀 -itious 构成 repetitious，核心义「同一件事再回来一遍」。

sensesIntro.en: Repetitious starts with plain recurrence, then turns into the tedium of too much of it, and finally settles into pattern, habit and worn-out phrasing.
sensesIntro.cn: repetitious 先指单纯的反复，再转指重复过多的厌烦，最后落到规律纹样、说话习惯与被用滥的表达。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one sentence is read aloud again and again while the listeners sigh.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一句话被一遍遍念出来，听的人只能叹气。

branches.en: PLAIN RECURRENCE: the same act comes round again in the same way.
branches.cn: 单纯反复线：同一个动作以同样的方式再来一轮。

branches.en: COMPLAINT: too many repeats make the text tiring to read or hear.
branches.cn: 抱怨线：重复太多让文本读起来或听起来累人。

branches.en: PATTERN: a design or habit that returns on a regular beat.
branches.cn: 图案线：按规律节拍回来的纹样或习惯。

branches.en: PERSON AND ADVERB: a speaker telling the same thing, and the manner of doing something over and over.
branches.cn: 人与副词线：一个反复讲同一件事的人，以及一遍遍做某事的方式。

branches.en: WEAR: sameness turns dull, and a phrase used too often turns stale.
branches.cn: 磨损线：雷同变得乏味，用得太多的说法变得陈旧。

intro.en: Repetitious is a Latin verb with a Latin suffix, and English adds adverbs and nouns around it.
intro.cn: repetitious 是拉丁动词词干配拉丁后缀，英语再在周围加上副词与名词形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin repetere means to seek again or fetch back, and repetitio means a repetition.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 repetere 意为再寻求、再取回，repetitio 意为重复。

items.example: The prefix marks a return of the same act.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出同一动作的回返。

items.example: The verb supplies the seeking image.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供「求取」的意象。

items.meaning: to seek again, fetch back, say again
items.example: Going back for the same thing is the source image.
items.exampleCN: 回去取同一样东西就是本源意象。

items.example: The noun is the base of the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是形容词的基础。

items.meaning: full of, of the nature of
items.example: The suffix -itious means full of repetition.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -itious 意为充满重复。

items.example: Repetition is the plain noun of the family.
items.exampleCN: repetition 是这一词族的普通名词。

items.example: The suffix -itive gives the neutral twin of repetitious.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -itive 造出 repetitious 的中性姊妹词。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms repetitiously.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 repetitiously。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms repetitiousness.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ness 构成 repetitiousness。

items.example: The adverb describes doing something over and over.
items.exampleCN: 这个副词描述一遍遍做某事。

definition_zh: 重新装满；补充；补充精力；重新添满
definition_en: to fill something up again, or to make a supply full or new once more
core_image: 空桶被重新舀满，水面再一次涨到桶沿
scene: 长途徒步前一天，向导清点行囊，把水壶重新灌满。At each campsite they replenish their water bottles from a stream.
sceneCN: 这里 replenish 是「重新装满」（第 1 个义项，指把空的容器再一次装满）；句意为他们在每个营地都从小溪重新灌满水壶。

pos.zh: 及物动词：重新装满；补充（供应）；使重新充满

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「补充；再装满；补给」
同出拉丁语 plenus（满是）的形容词，义为「大量；充足」
同出 plenus 的形容词，义为「全体出席的；完全的」
由 com- 与 plere（装满）构成，义为「完整的；完全的」
由 de- 与 plere（装满）构成的反面对照词，义为「耗尽；使枯竭」

senses.title: To fill something up again
senses.definition: to fill a container that has become empty once more
senses.definitionCN: 把已经空了的容器再一次装满
senses.example: She replenished the water jug before the guests arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 她在客人到来之前把水壶重新灌满。
senses.why: Latin plenus means full, and the prefix re- means again; replenish is literally to make full a second time.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 plenus 意为「满的」，前缀 re- 意为「再」；replenish 字面上就是再让它满一次。

senses.title: To restock a supply
senses.definition: to bring supplies that have been used up back to a full level
senses.definitionCN: 把已经用掉的存货补回到满额水平
senses.example: The shop replenishes its shelves every Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 这家商店每周一补满货架。
senses.why: A supply is treated like a container: as goods are taken out, the level falls, and replenishing brings it back to the brim.
senses.whyCN: 供应被当作一只容器：货被取走，水平就下降，补充就是把它重新推回桶沿。

senses.title: To restore energy or strength
senses.definition: to give someone or something back the energy or strength that had run low
senses.definitionCN: 把已经消耗掉的精力或体力重新补回
senses.example: A short nap replenished him before the long drive.
senses.exampleCN: 一小觉让他恢复了精力，好在长途驾驶中保持清醒。
senses.why: Energy is pictured as a fluid that drains away, so rest, food or sleep replenishes the hidden reservoir.
senses.whyCN: 精力被想象成会流失的液体，休息、进食或睡眠则把看不见的蓄水池重新注满。

senses.title: To renew something natural
senses.titleCN: 使（自然事物）重新充沛；涵养
senses.definition: to add to a natural store such as soil, groundwater or a forest
senses.definitionCN: 向土壤、地下水或森林等自然储备中再次添加
senses.example: Rotting leaves replenish the nutrients in the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 腐叶给土壤补充养分。
senses.why: Nature is seen as a vast container: what is taken out is put back by rain, by decay or by careful management.
senses.whyCN: 自然被看作一只巨大的容器：取走的东西靠降雨、腐烂或精心管理再放回去。

senses.title: To fill a cup or plate again
senses.definition: to pour more drink or serve more food into a glass or plate that is no longer full
senses.definitionCN: 把客人已经喝掉或吃掉的酒水、食物再添上，使杯子或盘子重新满起来
senses.example: The host replenished our glasses before the toast.
senses.exampleCN: 碰杯之前，主人又把我们的酒杯重新斟满。
senses.why: This is the oldest hospitality sense of the word: the guest has drunk, and etiquette asks the host to make the glass full again.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最古老的待客义：客人喝过了，礼节要求主人再把杯子弄满。

senses.title: To fill a gap or void again
senses.definition: to give something empty or lacking a new content
senses.definitionCN: 给空着或有所欠缺的事物重新注入内容
senses.example: New volunteers replenished the thinning ranks of the choir.
senses.exampleCN: 新志愿者充实了日益稀少的合唱团人数。
senses.why: The container is now abstract: ranks, a gap or a cupboard of ideas is refilled, and the fullness image travels with it.
senses.whyCN: 容器变得抽象了：队伍、空缺或创意库被重新填满，而「满」的意象随之迁移。

intro.en: Replenish comes from Latin plere, to fill, and its adjective plenus, full, with re- added again.
intro.cn: replenish 来自拉丁语 plere（装满）及其形容词 plenus（满的），再加上 re-（再）。

items.en: A root generally reconstructed as *pele or *pelh means to fill, and it is the deeper source of Latin plere; its exact form is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般认为有一个重构词根 *pele 或 *pelh 表示「装满」，是拉丁语 plere 的更早来源；具体形式不确定。

items.en: Plere means to fill, and its participle plenus gives the adjective full.
items.cn: plere 意为装满，其分词形式给出形容词 plenus（满的）。

items.en: Replere means to fill up again or refill, and from it come plentiful and plenty as the family spreads.
items.cn: replere 意为再装满、补满，词族由此扩展出 plentiful 与 plenty。

items.en: Old French replenir brings the verbal form into English, listed in some sources with the vowels shifted.
items.cn: 古法语 replenir 把动词形式带入英语，一些资料记录的词形元音略有变化。

items.en: Replenish is recorded from the fourteenth century with the sense to fill up again; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: replenish 自十四世纪起有记录，义为「重新装满」；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The modern word keeps the simple refilling sense for containers, supplies, the body, the soil and even the ranks of a group.
items.cn: 现代英语保留「再装满」的基本义，用于容器、补给、身体、土壤，甚至一个群体的队伍。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on Latin plere, to fill; the near-meaning group gathers words about refilling what has been used up.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁语 plere（装满）构成的一族词；近义组收表示「把用掉的补回来」的词，用法侧重各不相同。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of filling something up again or supplying it anew.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「补充、再装满」，指把某物重新注满或重新供应。

entries.definition: To use up or empty a supply; the direct opposite of replenish, built on the same filling root.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「耗尽、使枯竭」，与本词同出「装满」词根，是直接反义。

entries.definition: A large amount, more than enough, from Latin plenitas, fullness.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大量、充足」，源自拉丁语 plenitas（充满），与本词同根。

entries.definition: To fill a container again; plainer and more everyday than replenish.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重新灌满」，比 replenish 更口语，多用于杯子和瓶子。

entries.definition: To buy or bring in new stock to replace what has been sold or used.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「补货、补充库存」，侧重把卖走或用掉的存货重新买回来。

entries.definition: To clean and repair something so that it looks new; it only shares the ending and comes from a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「翻新、整修」，只是词尾与 replenish 相近，词源不同。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin root plenus, full, and the prefixes that reverse the action.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁词根 plenus（满的），以及能把动作反过来理解的前缀。

normal.en: Plenus means full in Latin, so replenish is to make full once more.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 plenus 意为「满的」，所以 replenish 就是再让它满一次。

normal.en: Re- is again, and the opposite prefix de- gives deplete, to drain the supply away.
normal.cn: re- 表示「再」，反向前缀 de- 则给出 deplete，把储备抽干。

normal.en: The same filling family gives plenty, plentiful and plenary, all full of something.
normal.cn: 同一「装满」词族给出 plenty、plentiful 与 plenary，都与「满」有关。

normal.en: The noun replenishment names the top-up; the verb replenish names the act of topping up.
normal.cn: 名词 replenishment 指「补上」这件事本身，动词 replenish 指把它补齐的动作。

normal.en: Replenish supplies, stocks and energy are the most common phrases in real use.
normal.cn: replenish supplies、stocks 与 energy 是实际使用中最常见的搭配。

abstract.en: Picture a bucket almost empty: the ladle goes down, water rises, and the rim is full again.
abstract.cn: 想象一只几乎见底的桶：水瓢舀下去，水面上升，桶沿再次满起。

abstract.en: Think of shelves that are half bare: the delivery van brings boxes, and the gaps close.
abstract.cn: 想象半空的货架：送货卡车送来纸箱，缝隙一道道合上。

abstract.en: Feel the tired body at the door: a meal and a nap pour strength back into it.
abstract.cn: 感受门口那个疲惫的身体：一顿饭加一小觉，把力气重新灌回去。

examples.en: We stopped at a village to replenish our fuel and food.
examples.cn: 我们在一个村子停下来补充燃料和食物。

examples.en: Rainwater replenishes the reservoir during the winter months.
examples.cn: 雨水在冬季补足水库蓄水。

examples.en: The retreat is designed to replenish body and mind after a hard term.
examples.cn: 这次静修意在让人在辛苦一学期后补充身心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞普莱尼许」——桶见底了，再舀一瓢把它灌满；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再）+ plere（装满），同族形容词 plenus（满的）→ replere（再装满）→ 古法语 replenir → 英语 replenish，核心义「让空掉的容器再一次变满」。

sensesIntro.en: Replenish keeps a single picture of a container made full again, and that container changes from a jug to supplies, to the body, to the soil, to a cup and finally to an abstract gap.
sensesIntro.cn: replenish 始终保持「容器再一次变满」的画面，容器从水壶变成补给、身体、土壤、酒杯，最后变成抽象的空缺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty bucket is filled again until the water reaches the rim.
core.cn: 核心意象：空桶被重新舀满，水面涨回桶沿。

branches.en: THE CONTAINER: a jug, a bottle or a glass is filled again, and the hospitality sense of refilling a guest glass is the oldest one.
branches.cn: 容器线：水壶、瓶子或酒杯被重新注满，待客时给客人再斟一杯是最古老的用例。

branches.en: THE SHELF: a supply is a container of goods, and a refill is a restocking.
branches.cn: 货架线：某类供应就是一只装货的容器，补满就是补货。

branches.en: THE BODY: energy is a fluid that drains, and rest replenishes the reservoir.
branches.cn: 身体线：精力是会流失的液体，休息把蓄水池重新注满。

branches.en: THE LAND: soil and groundwater are the natural stores that rain and decay fill again.
branches.cn: 土地线：土壤与地下水是自然储备，靠降雨与腐烂的回归重新填满。

branches.en: THE GAP: a group or a lack is refilled in the same way as an empty box.
branches.cn: 空缺线：一个队伍或一处欠缺，像空盒子一样被重新填上。

intro.en: Replenish is a Latin verb made of a prefix and a filling root, and English adds -ment to name the action.
intro.cn: replenish 是由前缀与「装满」词根组成的拉丁动词，英语再加 -ment 来给这个动作命名。

latinIntro.en: Latin plere, plenus and replere are all recorded, so only the deeper Indo-European root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 plere、plenus 与 replere 均有文献记录，只有更早的印欧词根属于重构形式。

items.example: The prefix marks the second filling.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀标出第二次的装满。

items.example: The verb is the filling root of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一词族的「装满」词根。

items.example: The adjective gives the image of a full container.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词提供「容器已满」的意象。

items.example: Adding the prefix to the root gives the refilling verb.
items.exampleCN: 在词根前加前缀，就得到「重新装满」的动词。

items.example: The suffix -ment forms replenishment.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ment 构成 replenishment。

items.example: Replenishment names the top-up.
items.exampleCN: replenishment 指把东西补上这件事。

items.example: The prefix de- reverses the filling in deplete.
items.exampleCN: 在 deplete 中，前缀 de- 把「装满」反过来。

items.example: Deplete is the direct opposite of replenish.
items.exampleCN: deplete 是 replenish 的直接反义。

items.example: Plenty keeps the fullness of the root.
items.exampleCN: plenty 保留了词根「满」的含义。

items.example: Plenary also means full in a formal way.
items.exampleCN: plenary 也以正式方式表示「满」。
